a: Vekabbalot, hazzaot, vehashekaat sota, vaarifat egla arufa, vetohorat metzora, unesiut kappayim – ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, talmud lomar "mibbene aharon" – avoda haamura livne aharon.
Vechol kohen sheeno mode bah – en lo chelek bakkehunna. tama deeno mode bah, ha mode bah – af al gav deeno baki bahen.
Amar rabbi abba, amar rav huna, amar rav: chutin shebballechi asurim, vechol kohen sheeno yodea littelan – en notnin lo mattana.
Vela hi, i betavya – medav dayyvi, vei lekidra – i dimychattech lehu umalach lehu – medav dayyvi.
Amar rava: badak lan rav yosef, hay kahana dechatef mattenata – chabbove ka mechabbev mitzva, o zalzole ka mezalzel bemitzva? ufeshatna leh "venatan" – velo sheyyittol meatzmo.

Amar abbaye: meresh hava chatefna mattenata, amena: chabbove ka mechabbevna mitzva. kevan dishmana leha "venatan" – velo sheyyittol meatzmo, michtaf la chatefna, memar (amari) [amena]: havu li. vechevan dishmana leha detanya: "vayyittu achare habbatza", rabbi meir omer: bene shemuel chelkam shaalu befihem, memar name la amena, vei yahavu li – shakelna.
Kevan dishmana leha detanya: hatztzenuim moshchin et yedehem, vehaggargeranim cholkim – mishkal name la shakelna, levar mimmaale yoma dechippure, leachzoke nafshay bechahane.
Velifros yedeh! anseh leh iddaneh.
Amar rav yosef: hay kahana deit leh tzureba merabbanan beshivavuteh, udechika leh milleta – lizakke leh mattenata, veaf al gav dela ate lideh, bemakkare kehunna uleviyya.

Rava verav safra ikkelau leve mar yochana bereh derav chana bar adda, veamri la leve mar yochana bereh derav chana bar bizna. aved lehu igla tilta, amar leh rava leshammaeh: zakki lan mattenata, divena lemechal lishshana bechardela.
Zakki leh. rava achal, verav safra la achal. akreyu lerav safra bechelma: "maade beged beyom kara chometz al nater veshar bashshirim al lev ra".

Ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: dilma mishshum daavari ashshemata demar akreyuyn hachi? amar leh: ki amari ana – beacher, shammaa – beal kurcheh mezakke, vechi amari ana – leman dela efshar leh, ha efshar leh.
Veella may tama akreyuyn hachi? kelappe rava! velakreyu lerava? rava nazuf hava.
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: ufeshateh dikra bemay ketiv? amar leh: beshone letalmid sheeno hagun.

Deamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun – nofel begehinnam, shenneemar "kol choshech tamun litzpunav teochlehu esh lo nuppach yera sarid beoholo", veen "sarid" ella talmid chacham, shenneemar "uvasseridim asher Adonai kore".
Amar rabbi zera amar rav: kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun – kezorek even lemerkulis, shenneemar: "kitzror even bemargema ken noten lichsil kavod", uchetiv: "lo nave lichsil taanug".
Vehammishtattef immahen tzarich lirshom, vaafillu im haggoy. ureminhu: hammishtattef im kohen – tzarich lirshom, vehammishtattef im haggoy ufesule hammukedashim – en tzarich lirshom!
b: Hacha bemay askinan – deyatev goy ammesachta.
Dichvata gabbe chohen, deyatev ammesachta, ammay tzarich lirshom? deamri: bisra ka zaven. i hachi, goy name amri: bisra ka zaven!
Ella hacha bemay askinan, deyatev goy akkaspeta. dichvata gabbe kohen deyatev akkaspeta, ammay tzarich lirshom? amri: hemone hemneh, goy name amri: hemone hemneh!
En emuna begoy. ibbaet ema: setam goy mippea pae.
Amar mar: ufesule hammukedashin en tzarich lirshom. alma mochcha milleta, veha anan tenan: pesule hammukedashin nimkarim baitliz, venishchatim baitliz, venishkalim belitra!
Targema rav adda bar ahava kammeh derav pappa, beotan hannimkarim betoch habbayit.

Amar rav huna: shuttaf barosh – patur min hallechi, shuttaf bayyad – patur min hazzeroa, shuttaf bivne meayin – patur min hakkeva. vechiyyay bar rav amar: afillu shuttaf beachat mehen – patur mikkullan.

Metivi: "harosh shelli vechullah shellach", vaafillu echad mimmea barosh – patur. "hayyad shelli vechullah shellach", afillu echad mimmea bayyad – patur. "bene meayin shelli vechullah shellach", afillu echad mimmea bahen – patur.
May lav: patur min hallechi vechayyayv bechullan, patur min hazzeroa vechayyayv bechullan, patur min hakkeva vechayyayv bechullan? la, patur mikkullan.
Velitne patur mikkullan! veod, tanya: harosh shelli vechullah shellach – afillu echad mimmea barosh patur min hallechi vechayyayv bechullan. teyuveta dechiyyay bar rav, teyuveta!
Amar rav chisda: ha matnita atiteh lechiyyay bar rav, detanya: esrim vearba mattenot kehunna hen, vechullan nittenu leaharon ulevanav bichlal uferat uverit melach.
Kol hamekayyeyman – keillu kiyyem bichlal uferat uverit melach, vechol haover alehen – keillu over al bichlal uferat uverit melach.

Veellu hen: eser bammikdash, vearba birushalayim, veeser baggevulim. eser bammikdash: chattat, vechattat haof, asham vadday, veasham taluy, vezivche shalme tzibbur, velog shemen shel metzora, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot, uminchat haomer.
Vearba birushalayim: habbechora, vehabbikkurim, umuram min hattoda umeel nazir, veorot kadashim.
Veeser baggevulim: teruma, uterumat maaser, vechalla, vereshit haggez, umattanot, ufidyon habben, ufidyon peter chamor.
Usede achuzza, usede charamim, vegezel hagger.

Hu savar: middeka chashev lehu lemattanot bachada – chada ninhu, vela hi! attu muram mittoda veel nazir deka chashev lehu kachada – mishshum dachada ninhu?! ella, kevan dedamyayn lahadade – chashev lehu kachada, hachi name: kevan dedamyayn lahadade – chashiv lehu kachada.
Ibbaya lehu: harosh shellecha vechullah shelli, mahu? batar chiyyuva azlinan, vechiyyuva gabbe yisrael hu, o dilma batar ikkar behema azlinan, veikkar behema dechohen hu?
Ta shema: goy vechohen shemmasru tzonam leyisrael ligzoz – patur, hallokeach gez tzono shel goy – patur mereshit haggez.
Veze chomer bizroa uvallechayayim uvekeva, yoter mereshit haggez. shema minna batar chiyyuva azlinan, shema minna.
Veim amar lo "chutz min hammattanot" – patur min hammattanot.

a: Ureminhu: "al menat shehammattanot shelli" – noten lechol kohen sheyyirtze!
"Al menat" achutz" ka ramet? "chutz" – shiyyura, "al menat" – lav shiyyura.
Ureminhu: "al menat shehammattanot shelli" – hammattanot shello! beha peligi: mar savar "al menat" – shiyyura hu, umar savar "al menat" – lav shiyyura hu.
Amar lo: mechor li bene meeha vechulei. amar rav: lo shanu ella sheshshakal leatzmo, aval shakal lo tabbach – haddin im hattabbach. verav assi amar: afillu shakal lo tabbach – haddin immo.
Lema bidrav chisda ka mippalgi, deamar rav chisda: gazal velo nityayashu habbealim, uva acher vaachalo – ratza mizze gove, ratza mizze gove. demar it leh derav chisda, umar let leh derav chisda.
La, dechulle alma it lehu derav chisda, vehacha bemattenot kehunna nigzalot ka mippalgi, demar savar nigzalot, umar savar en nigzalot.
Ikka dematne la leha shemata bifne atzmah: rav amar: mattenot kehunna nigzalot, verav assi amar: mattenot kehunna en nigzalot.
Mishna ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo para, nishchata ad shello nitgayyer – patur, mishshennitgayyer – chayyayv, safek – patur, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Gemara ki ata rav dimi amar: rame leh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan – tenan: "safek patur", alma sefeka lekulla.
Ureminhu: chore hannemalim shebbetoch hakkama – hare ellu shel baal habbayit, veshelleachar hakkotzrim – haelyonim laaniyyim, vehattachtonim shel baal habbayit.
Rabbi meir omer: hakkol laaniyyim, shessefek leket – leket.
Amar leh: al takniteni, shebbilshon yachid ani shone otah, detanya: rabbi yehuda ben agra omer mishshum rabbi meir: sefek leket – leket, sefek shichcha – shichcha, sefek pea – pea.
Amar lo al tishne otah ella bilshon ben taddal, veha tama kaamar, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: may dichtiv "ani varash hatzediku"? may "hatzediku"?
Illema bedinim, veha ketiv "vedal lo tehdar berivo"? ella, tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo.
Amar rava: hacha, para bechezkat petura kayyma, kama bechezkat chiyyuva kayyma.
Amar leh abbaye: vahare issa naaset ad shello nitgayyer – patur min hachalla, mishshennitgayyer – chayyayv, safek – chayyayv.
Amar leh: sefek issura lechumera, sefek mamona lekulla.
Daamar rav chisda, vechen tane rabbi chiyyay: shemona sefekot neemru bagger, arba lechiyyuv vearba liftur.
Korban ishto, vechalla, uvechor behema temea, uvechor behema tehora – lechiyyuv.
b: Reshit haggez vehammattanot, ufidyon habben, ufidyon peter chamor – liftur.
Ki ata ravin, amar: kama akkama remi leh.
Levi zera bechishar, vela havo aniyyim lemishkal leket. ata lekammeh derav sheshet, amar leh: "leani velagger taazov otam", velo leorvim velo laatallefim.
Metivi: en meviin teruma, lo miggoren lair, velo mimmidbar layyishshuv, veim en sham kohen – socher para umeviah, mippene hefsed teruma.
Shane teruma, detavla, vela saggi dela mafresh la.
Vahare mattanot, dela tavli, vetanya: makom shennahagu limlog baagalim – lo yafshit et hazzeroa.
Lehafeshit et harosh – lo yafshit et hallechi, veim en sham kohen – maalin otan bedamim veochlan, mippene hefsed kohen.
Shane mattenot kehunna, dintina ketiva beh. hasheta deatet lehachi, teruma name netina ketiva beh.
Veella "taazov" yattira lema li?
Lechidtanya: hammafkir et karmo, velashshachar hishkim uvetzaro – chayyayv beferet uveolelot uveshichcha uvefea, ufatur min hammaasrot.
Hahu sakka dedinare daata leve midresha, kadem rabbi amme uzecha bahen. vehechi aved hachi? veha ketiv "venatan" velo sheyyittol meatzmo! rabbi amme name laaniyyim zacha bahen.
Veibbaet ema: adam chashuv shane, detanya: "vehakkohen haggadol meechav" – sheyyehe gadol meechav benoy, bechachma, uveosher.
Acherim omrim: minnayin sheim en lo, sheechav hakkohanim megaddelin oto? talmud lomar: "vehakkohen haggadol meechav" – gaddelehu mishshel echav.

Mishna ezehu hazzeroa? min happerek shel archubba ad kaf shel yad, vehu shel nazir, uchenegdo baregel – shok. rabbi yehuda omer: shok min happerek shel archubba ad sovech shel regel. e zehu lechi? min happerek shel lechi ad pika shel gargeret.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: hazzeroa – ze zeroa yamin. atta omer ze zeroa yamin, o eno ella zeroa semol? talmud lomar "hazzeroa".
May talmuda? kidamar rava: "hayyarech" – hameyummenet shebbayyarech, hacha name: "hazzeroa" – hameyumman shebbazzeroa.

"Vehallechayayim" lemay ata? lehavi tzemer shebberosh kevasim, vesear shebbizkan teyayshim. "vehakkeva" lemay ata? lehavi chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva, vechelev shebbetoch hakkeva. deamar rabbi yehoshua: kohanim nahagu bo ayin yafa unetanuhu labbealim. tama denahagu, ha lo nahagu – dideh hu.
Dorshe chamurot hayu omrim: hazzeroa – keneged hayyad, vechen hu omer: "vayyikkach romach beyado".
Ulechayayim – keneged tefilla, vechen hu omer: "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel", keva – kemishmaah, vechen hu omer: "veet haishsha el kovatah".
Vetanna mayyte la mehacha: "shok hayyamin" – en li ella shok hayyamin, zeroa mukedashin minnayin? talmud lomar "teruma". zeroa chullin minnayin? talmud lomar "tittenu".
Ezehu lechi – min happerek shel lechi vead pikka shel gargeret, vehatanya: notlah uvet shechita immah?
La kashya: ha rabbanan, veha rabbi chanina ben antignos.
Detanya: mugeremet pesula, heid rabbi chanina ben antignos al mugeremet shehi keshera.
Ibbaet ema: ha veha rabbanan, umay "immah"? immah divhema.
Hadaran alach hazzeroa vehallechayayim.

a: Mishna reshit haggez noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bachullin aval lo bammukedashim.

Chomer bazzeroa ulechayayim uvakkeva mereshit haggez – shehazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagin babbakar uvatztzon, bimrubbe uvemuat, vereshit haggez eno noheg ella birchelot, veeno noheg ella bimrubbe.
Vechamma hu merubbe, bet shammay omrim: shete rechelot, shenneemar: "yechayye ish eglat bakar ushete tzon", uvet hillel omrim: chamesh, shenneemar: "chamesh tzon asuyot".
Rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer: chamesh rechelot gozzot mane mane uferas chayyayvot bereshit haggez, vachachamim omrim: chamesh rechelot gozzot kol shehen.
Vechamma notnin lo? mishkal chamesh selaim bihuda, shehen eser selaim baggalil, melubban velo tzoi, kede laasot mimmennu beged katan, shenneemar "titten lo", sheyyehe bo kede mattana.
Lo hispik litteno lo ad shetztzevao – patur, libbeno velo tzevao – chayyayv.

Hallokeach gez tzono shel goy – patur mereshit haggez. hallokeach gez tzono shel chavero, im shiyyer – hammocher chayyayv, lo shiyyer – hallokeach chayyayv. hayu lo shene minim, shechufot ulevanot, machar lo shechufot aval lo levanot, zecharim aval lo nekevot – ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo.
Gemara bemukedashin, may tama la? amar kera "tzoncha", velo tzon hekdesh.
Tama dichtav rachamana "tzoncha", ha lav hachi hava amena kadashim chayyayvim bereshit haggez? ha lav bene gizza ninhu, dichtiv "velo tagoz bechor tzonecha"!
I bekodshe mizbeach, hachi name. hacha bemay askinan – bekodshe bedek habbayit.
Vehaamar rabbi elazar: kodshe bedek habbayit asurim begizza vaavoda! midderabbanan. salka datach amena: hoil umiddeorayyta bene gizza ninhu, hecha digzaz leh – littev leh.
Veha kaddesh la! salka datach amena: lifrok velittev leh.
Veha bae haamada vehaaracha! hanicha leman deamar kodshe bedek habbayit lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, ella leman deamar hayu, may ikka lememar?
Amar rabbi mani bar pattish mishshum rabbi yannay: hacha bemakdish behemto levedek habbayit chutz miggizzoteha. salka datach amena: ligzoz velittev leh, amar kera "tzoncha", velo tzon shel hekdesh.
I hachi, kodshe mizbeach name! kachashi.
Kodshe bedek habbayit name kachashi! deamar: chutz miggizza uchechisha.
Kodshe mizbeach name! deamar: chutz miggizza uchechisha, afillu hachi pashta kedushsha bechulla.

Umena temra, deamar rabbi yose: vahalo bemukedashin, haomer "raglah shel zo ola" – kullah ola. vaafillu lerabbi meir deamar en kullah ola, hane mille deakdesh davar sheen hanneshama teluya bo, aval hikdish davar shehanneshama teluya bo – kadsha.
Rava amar: bemakdish gizza atzmah, salka datach amena: ligzoz velifrok velittev leh,
Amar kera: "gez tzoncha titten lo", mi sheen mechussar ella geziza unetina, yatza ze shemchussar geziza pediyyay unetina.
Ella "tzoncha" lemay ata? lechidtanya: behemat hashshuttafim chayyayv bereshit haggez, verabbi ilay poter. may tama derabbi ilay? amar kera "tzoncha", velo shel shuttafut.
Verabbanan, lemaote shuttafut goy. verabbi ilay, shuttafut goy mena leh?
Nafka leh meresha dikra, "reshit degancha", velo shuttafut goy.
Verabbanan, "reshit" (haggez) hifsik hainyan.
Verabbi ilay: vav hadar arveh.
b: Verabbanan: la nichtov rachamana la vav vela "reshit".
Verabbi ilay, ayyeyde dehay kedushshat damim, vehay kedushshat hagguf, pasek lehu, vahadar arvi lehu.

Veibbaet ema: shuttafut goy bitruma, rabbanan chayyove mechayyeyvi, detanya: yisrael vegoy shellakchu sade beshuttafut – tevel vechullin meoravim ze baze, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shel yisrael chayyayv, veshel goy patur.
Ad kan la peligi, ella demar savar yesh berera, umar savar en berera, aval shuttafut degoy – divre hakkol chayyevet.
Vei baet ema, tarvayyhu lerabbi ilay mitztzoncha" nafka.
Shuttafut degoy may tama? dela meyaychada leh, leyisrael name la meyaychada leh. verabbanan? goy lav bar chiyyuva hu, yisrael bar chiyyuva hu.
Amar rava: mode rabbi ilay bitruma, af al gav dichtiv "degancha" – didach in, deshuttafut la.
Ketav rachamana "terumotechem", ella "degancha" lema li? lemaote shuttafut goy.
Challa, af al gav dichtiv "reshit", veikka lememar: nelaf "reshit" "reshit" mereshit haggez – ma lehallan deshuttafut la, af kan deshuttafut la. ketav rachamana "arisotechem".
Ella tama dichtiv "arisotechem", ha lav hachi hava amena nelaf "reshit" "reshit" mereshit haggez? adderabba, nelaf mitteruma!
Hachi name, ella "arisotechem" lema li? kede arisotechem.
Pea, af al gav dichtiv "sadcha" – didach in, shuttafut la – ketav rachamana "uvekutzrechem et ketzir artzechem". ella "sadcha" lema li? lemaote shuttafut goy.
Bechora, af al gav dichtiv "kol habbechor asher yivvaled bivkarcha uvetzoncha", didach – in, deshuttafut – la.
Ketav rachamana: "uvechorot bekarchem vetzonchem", ella "bekarcha vetzoncha" lema li? lemaote shuttafut goy.
Mezuza, af al gav dichtiv "betecha" – didach in, shuttafut la, ketav rachamana "lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem". veella "betecha" lemay ata? lechidrabba, deamar rabba:

a: Derech biatcha min hayyamin.
Maaser, af al gav dichtiv "masar degancha" – dilach in, deshuttafut la. ketav rachamana "maserotechem". ella "masar degancha" lemay ata? lemaote shuttafut degoy.
Mattanot, af al gav dichtav rachamana "venatan".
Ikka lememar, yalef "netina" "netina" mereshit haggez – ma lehallan deshuttafut la, af kan deshuttafut la. ketav rachamana "meet zovche hazzevach".
Ella tama dichtav rachamana "meet zovche hazzevach", ha lav hachi hava amena lelaf mereshit haggez? adderabba nelaf mitteruma.
In hachi name, meet "zovche hazzevach" lema li? lechidrava, deamar rava: haddin im hattabbach.
Bikkurim, af al gav dichtiv "artzecha" – didach in, deshuttafut la.
Ketav rachamana "bikkure kol asher (beartzecha) [beartzam]", ella "artzecha" lema li? lemaote chutza laaretz.
Tzitzit, af al gav dichtav rachamana "kesutecha" – didach in, deshuttafut la.
Ketav rachamana "al kanfe vigdehem ledorotam", veella "kesutecha" lema li? lechidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: tallit sheula petura min hatztzitzit kol sheloshim yom.
Maake, af al gav dichtav rachamana "legaggecha" – didach in, deshuttafut la.
Ketav rachamana "ki yippol hannofel mimmennu", ella "gaggecha" lemay ata? lemaote batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot.
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye: letanhu lehane kelale, detanya: behemat hashshuttafin chayyevet bivchora, verabbi ilay potrah.
May tama derabbi ilay? dichtiv: "bekarcha vetzoncha", veha ketiv: "bekarchem vetzonchem"! dechullehu yisrael.

Amar rav chanina missura: letanhu lehane kelale, detanya: behemat hashshuttafin chayyevet bemattanot, verabbi ilay poter. may tama? yalef "netina" "netina" mereshit haggez – ma lehallan deshuttafut la, af kan deshuttafut la.
Vei salka datach bitruma michayyayv, nelaf "netina" "netina" mitteruma! ella shema minna bitruma name poter.

I ma teruma, baaretz – in, bechutza laaretz – la, af mattanot, baaretz – in, bechutza laaretz – la! amar rabbi yose minneharbil: in, vehatanya, rabbi ilay omer: mattanot in nohagin ella baaretz, vechen haya rabbi ilay omer: reshit haggez in noheg ella baaretz.
May tama derabbi ilay? amar rava: yalef "netina" "netina" mitteruma: ma teruma, baaretz – in, bechutza laaretz – la, af reshit haggez, baaretz – in, bechutza laaretz – la.
Amar leh abbaye: i ma teruma tovelet, af reshit haggez tovelet? amar leh: amar kera "vereshit gez tzoncha titten lo" – en lecha bo ella mereshito veelach.
I ma teruma chayyayvim aleha mita vachomesh, af reshit haggez chayyayvim alav mita vachomesh?
Amar kera: "umetu vo", "veyasaf alav" – "alav" velo al reshit haggez, "bo" velo bereshit haggez.
I ma teruma rishon vesheni achareha, af reshit haggez rishon vesheni achareha! amar kera "reshit", en lecha bo ella reshit bilvad.
I ma teruma, mechadash al hayyashan – la, af reshit haggez, mechadash al hayyashan – la? in.
Vehatanya: hayu lo shete rechelot, gazaz vehinniach, gazaz vehinniach, shetayim veshalosh shanim – en mitztarfot. ha chamesh – mitztarfot.
Vehatanya: en mitztarfot! ella shema minna: ha derabbi ilay, veha derabbanan.
I ma teruma, gadel bechiyyuv – chayyayv, gadel biftur – patur, af reshit haggez name: gadel bechiyyuv – chayyayv, biftur – patur!
Vegabbe teruma menalan? detanya: yisrael shellakach sade besureya miggoy, ad shello hevia shelish – chayyayv, mishshehevia shelish – rabbi akiva mechayyev betosefet, vachachamim potrin.
Vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: hallokeach gez tzon goy – patur mereshit haggez, ha tzono ligzoz – chayyayv! matnitin
b: Dela kerabbi ilay.
I ma teruma, mimmin al sheeno mino – lo, af reshit haggez mimmin al sheeno mino – lo?

Vegabbe teruma menalan? detanya: hayu lo shene mine teenim, shechorot ulevanot, vechen shene mine chittin – en tormim umeasserim mizze al ze. rabbi yitzchak omer mishshum rabbi ilay: bet shammay omrim en tormin, uvet hillel omrim tormin. af reshit haggez mimmin al sheeno mino – lo.
In, vehatnan: hayu lo shene minim shechufot ulevanot, machar lo shechufot aval lo levanot – ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo.
Ella meatta, sefa dekatane: zecharim aval lo nekevot – ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo, hachi name mishshum ditre mine ninhu?
Ella, etza tova ka mashma lan, delittev leh mehay derakkich umehay deashshun. hacha name, etza tova ka mashma lan, delittev lehu mittarvayyhu.
Ha okemna lematnitin dela kerabbi ilay.
I ma teruma, baenan reshit sheshsheyareha nikkarin, af reshit haggez sheshsheyareha nikkarin? in.
Vehatnan: haomer "kol gorni teruma vechol issati challa" – lo amar kelum, ha "kol gizzayy reshit" – devarav kayyaymin, vetanya iddach: lo amar kelum.
Ella lav shema minna, ha rabbi ilay, veha rabbanan. shema minna.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: haiddana nehug alma kehane telat save, kerabbi ilay bereshit haggez, detanya: rabbi ilay omer: reshit haggez eno noheg ella baaretz.
Ucherabbi yehuda ben betira bedivre tora, detanya: rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: en divre tora mekabbelin tumea.
Ucherabbi yoshiyya bechilayim, detanya: rabbi yoshiyya omer: leolam en chayyayv ad sheyyizra chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad.
Chomer bizroa [vechulei]. velitne chomer bereshit haggez, shennoheg bitrefot, ma sheen ken bemattanot!

Amar ravina: ha manni? rabbi shimon hi, detanya: rabbi shimon poter et hatterefot mereshit haggez. may tama derabbi shimon? yalef "netina" "netina" mimmattanot – ma mattanot, terefa – la, af reshit haggez name, terefa – la.

Vei yalef netina netina mimmattanot, lelaf netina netina mitteruma, ma teruma: baaretz – in, bechutza laaretz – la, af reshit haggez name: baaretz – in, bechutza laaretz – la. allema tenan: reshit haggez noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz?
Ella, hayeynu tama derabbi shimon, deyalef "tzon" "tzon" mimmaaser – ma maaser, terefa – la, af reshit haggez, terefa – la.
Vehatam menalan? dichtiv "kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet" – perat litrefa sheenah overet. velelaf "tzon" "tzon" mibbechor – ma bechor afillu terefa, af reshit haggez afillu terefa!
Mistabbera mimmaaser hava leh lemelaf, shekken zecharim temein.
Bimrubbin, merechem.
Adam, pashut, lifne haddibbur.
Adderabba, mibbechor hava leh lemelaf, shekken: yatom, shellakchu.
Beshuttafut, natnu; bifne kohen,

a: Bikdushsha, umechira – vehanach nefishin!
Pashut mippashut adif leh.

Reshit haggez eno noheg ella birchelim. mena hane mille? amar rav chisda: atya gizza gizza, ketiv hacha "reshit gez tzoncha titten lo", uchetiv hatam "umiggez kevasay yitchammam", ma lehallan kevasim, af kan kevasim.
Venelaf "gizza" "gizza" mibbechor, detanya: "lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz bechor tzonecha" – en li ella shor baavoda vetzon begizza.
Minnayin litten haamur shel ze baze, veet haamur shel ze baze? talmud lomar "lo taavod velo tagoz".
Amar kera: "titten lo", velo lesakko.
Ella meatta, notza shel izzim lichayyayv? baenan gizza, velekka!
Man shamat leh hay sevara? rabbi yose – ha mode rabbi yose bemidde deorcheh!
Ella, kidamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: "laamod lesharet" – davar harauy lesherut, hacha name – davar harauy lesherut.
Ella "gizza" "gizza" lemay ata? lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: kevasim shetztzamran kashe peturim mereshit haggez, shenneemar "umiggez kevasay yitchammam".
Tane chada: gozez et haizzim veshotef et harchelim – patur, vetanya iddach: haggozez et haizzim – patur, veshotef et harchelim – chayyayv. la kashya: ha rabbanan, veha rabbi yose.
Detanya: "leket ketzircha" – velo leket kittuf. rabbi yose omer: en leket ella habba mechamat katzir.
Rabbi yose hayeynu tanna kamma? kullah rabbi yose hi, vehachi katane: sherabbi yose omer, en leket ella habba mechamat katzir.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: mode rabbi yose bemidde deorcheh, detanya: rabbi yose omer: "katzir" – en li ella katzir, oker minnayin?
Talmud lomar "liktzor", tolesh minnayin? talmud lomar "bekutzerecha".
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: af anan name tenena: malbenot betzalim shebben hayyarak, rabbi yose omer: pea mikkol echad veechad, vachachamim omrim: meachat al hakkol.
Vechamma hu merubbe? bishlama levet shammay – tarte name ikkero "tzon", ella levet hillel – may tama?
Amar rav kahana: amar kera "asuyot", sheosot shete mitzvot: reshit haggez umattanot. ema bechora umattanot?
Bechora, chada mi la michayyeyva? uletamaych, mattanot, chada mi la michayyeyva? ella amar rav ashe: "asuyot" – shemmeassot et baalehen, veomrot lo: "kum ase mitzva".
Tanya deve rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: arba, shenneemar: "vearba tzon tachat hasse".
Tanya, amar rabbi: ilmale divrehen divre tora, vedivre beribbi kabbala – anan divre beribbi shomin, vechol shekken sheddivrehem divre kabbala, vedivre beribbi divre tora.
Vehaamar mar: en hacheraa shelishit machraat!
b: Amar rabbi yochanan: mippi shemua amra, mippi chaggay zecharya umalachi.
Rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer vechulei. vechamma "kol shehen"? amar rav: mane uferas, uvilvad sheyyehu mechummashot, ushemuel amar: shishshim, venoten sela achat lechohen.
Rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shesh – lechohen chamesh, veachat lo. ulla amar rabbi elazar: "kol shehen" shaninu.
Tenan: vechamma noten lo? mishkal chamesh selaim bihuda, shehen eser selaim baggalil. bishlama lerav verabbi yochanan – nicha, ella lishmuel verabbi elazar – kashya!
Velitamaych, ulerav mi nicha? veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: reshit haggez beshishshim!
Ha ittemar ala dehahi, rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: beyisrael sheyyesh lo gizzin harebe askinan, umevakkesh littenan lechohen, veamrinan leh: kol chad vechad la tevatztzar leh mechameshet selaim.
Gufa: rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: reshit haggez beshishshim, teruma beshishshim, pea beshishshim.
Teruma beshishshim? veha anan tenan: teruma ayin yafa – echad mearbaim! deorayyta – beshishshim, derabbanan – bearbaim.
Deorayyta beshishshim? vehaamar shemuel: chitta achat poteret et hakkeri! deorayyta – kedishmuel, derabbanan bidorayyta – achat mearbaim, derabbanan bidrabbanan – beshishshim.
Pea beshishshim, vehatnan: ellu devarim sheen lahen shiur: happea, vehabbikkurim, vehareayon. deorayyta – en lah shiur, derabbanan – beshishshim.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: en pochatin lappea mishshishshim, af al pi sheamru happea en lah shiur! hatam baaretz, hacha bechutza laaretz.

Ki selek isi bar hini, ashkecheh (lerabbi) [rabbi] yochanan deka matne leh livreh "rechelim", amar leh: atneyeh "rechelot", amar leh: kedichtiv "rechelim matayim", amar leh: leshon tora leatzmah, leshon chachamim leatzman.

Amar leh: man resh sidra bevavel? amar leh: abba aricha. amar leh: abba aricha karet leh?! dechirna kad hava yatevna achar sheva esre shuran achoreh derav kammeh derabbi, venafki zikkukin denur mippummeh derav lefummeh derabbi, umippummeh derabbi lefummeh derav, velet ana yada ma hen amrin, veat "abba aricha" karet leh?!
Amar leh ihu: reshit haggez bechamma? amar leh rabbi yochanan: beshishshim. vehaanan "bechol shehen" tenan! amar leh: im ken, ma ben li velach?
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: reshit haggez – rav amar beshishshim, verabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yannay amar beshesh. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: annacht lan chada veakshet lan chada.
Bishlama derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan la kashya: ha dideh, ha derabbeh.
Ella derav adderav kashya, deha amar rav mane uferas! derav adderav name la kashya, may mane dekaamar? ben arbaim selaim, dahava leh

a: Beshishshim, vetane tanna: mane ben arbaim selaim. in! vehatnan: chemet chadasha, af al pi shemmekabbelet rimmonim – tehora.
Tefarah venikrea – shiurah kemotzi rimmonim. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kefakiyyot shel sheti, achat mearba, bemane ben arbaim selaim.
Vechamma noten lo kulei. tana – lo sheyyelabbenennu veyittenennu lo, ella sheyyelabbenennu kohen veyaamod al chamesh selaim.
Kede laasot beged katan. menahane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: amar kera "laamod lesharet" – davar shehu rauy lesherut. may nihu? avnet.
Ema meil! tafasta merubbe – lo tafasta, tafasta muat – tafasta.
Veema kippa shel tzemer, detanya: kippa shel tzemer hayta munnachat berosh kohen gadol, vealeha tzitz natun, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "vesamta oto al petil techelet".
Amar kera "hu uvanav", davar hashshave leaharon ulevanav.
Avnet name la shave. hanicha leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol lo zehu avneto shel kohen hedyot – shappir.
Ella leman deamar zehu avneto shel kohen hedyot, may ikka lememar? shem avnet baolam.
Lo hispik litteno vechulei. ittemar: gazaz umachar rishona, rav chisda amar: chayyayv, rabbi natan bar hoshaya amar: patur.
Rav chisda amar chayyayv, deha gazaz. rabbi natan bar hoshaya amar patur, beiddana deka male shiura baenan "tzoncha", velekka.
Tenan: hallokeach gez tzono shel goy, patur mereshit haggez. ha tzono ligzoz – chayyayv. ammay? kol chad vechad batar gizza nafka la mershuteh!
Targema rav chisda allibba derabbi natan bar hoshaya: kegon shehiknan lo kol sheloshim yom.
Hallokeach gez tzono shel chavero kulei. man tanna dehecha deikka shiyyura gabbe mocher, batar mocher azlinan?
Amar rav chisda: rabbi yehuda hi, ditnan: hammocher kilche ilan betoch sadehu – noten pea lechol echad veechad.
Amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman shello shiyyer baal hassade, aval shiyyer baal hassade – noten pea al hakkol.
Amar leh rava: veha mar hu deamar, vehu shehitchil baal hassade liktzor!

Vechi tema hachi name vehu shehitchil ligzoz – bishlama hatam, "uvekutzrechem et ketzir artzechem" ketiv, meiddana deatchel liktzor michayyayv bechulla sade, ella hacha, meiddana deatchel lemegaz la michayyayv bechulleh edreh!

Ella amar rava: hay tanna hu, ditnan: amar lo "mechor li bene meeha shel para zo", vehayu bahen mattanot – notnan lakkohen, veen menakke lo min haddamim. lakach mimmennu bemishkal – notnan lakkohen umenakke lo min haddamim.
b: Alma mattanot dechohen la mezabben inish, hacha name mattanot dechohen la mezabben inish. hilkach: shiyyer hammocher – mocher chayyayv, deamar leh lokeach: "mattana dechohen gabbach hi". lo shiyyer – lokeach chayyayv, deamar leh mocher: "mattana dechohen la zabbeni lach".
Hadaran alach reshit haggez.

Mishna shilluach hakken noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo bemukedashin. chomer bechissuy haddam mishshilluach hakken, shekkissuy haddam noheg bachayya uvaof, bimzumman uvesheen mezumman, veshilluach hakken eno noheg ella baof, veeno noheg ella besheeno mezumman.

Ezehu sheeno mezumman? kegon avavzin vetarnegolim shekkinnenu bappardes, aval im kinnenu babbayit, vechen yone haredasiyyaot – patur mishshilluach. of tame – patur milleshalleach, of tame rovetz al betze of tahor, vetahor rovetz al betze of tame – patur milleshalleach. kore zachar – rabbi eliezer mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.

Gemara rabbi avin verabbi meyaysha, chad amar: kol hecha ditnan "baaretz uvechutza laaretz" shello letzorech, levad mereshit haggez, leappoke midderabbi ilay deamar: "reshit haggez eno noheg ella baaretz".

Vechad amar: kol hecha ditnan "bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit" – shello letzorech, levad meoto veet beno". salka datach amena: hoil uveinyana dekadashim ketiv, bizman deikka kadashim – ninhog, bizman delekka kodashim – la ninhog, ka mashma lan.
Vetarvayyhu amri: kol hecha ditnan "bechullin uvemukedashim" – letzorech, levad miggid hannashe, peshita! mishshum deikkaddash peka leh issur gid hannashe minneh?
Velav okemna bevaldot kadashim?
Umay tama okemna? lav mishshum dekashya lan la litne? meikkara name la tikshe lach, ayyeyde ditna letzorech, tena name shello letzorech.
Bechullin aval lo bemukedashim. ammay la? deamar kera: "shalleach teshallach et haem" – bemi sheatta metzvvev leshallecho, yatza ze shei atta metzvvev leshallecho ella lahavio lide gizbar.

Amar ravina: hilkach, of tahor sheharag et hannefesh patur mishshilluach, may tama? deamar kera: "shalleach teshallach et haem" – bemi sheatta metzvvev leshallecho, yatza ze shei atta metzvvev leshallecho ella lahavio levet din. hechi dame? i digmar dineh –

a: Bar ketala hu, ella dela gemar dineh, uvae leetoyeh leve dina vekayyome beh "uviarta hara mikkirbecha".
Hane mukedashin hechi dame? illema dahava leh ken betoch beto veakdesheh – mi michayyayv? "ki yikkare kan tzippor" – perat limzumman.
Ella dachaza ken bealma veakdesheh, umi kadosh? "ish ki yakdish et beto kodesh" amar rachamana, ma beto birshuto, af kol birshuto.

Ella deagbehinhu leefrochim, veakdeshinhu, vahadar ahderinhu – hay afillu bechullin name la michayyayv, ditna: natal et habbanim vehechziran lakken, veachar kach chazra haem alehen – patur milleshalleach.

Ella, deagbeha leem, veakdesha, vahadara. meikkara ichayyayv leh beshilluach mikkamme deakdesha, detanya: rabbi yochanan ben yosef omer: hikdish chayya veachar kach shechatah – patur millechassot, shechatah veachar kach hikdishah – chayyayv lechassot, shekkevar nitchayyev bechissuy kodem sheyyavo lide hekdesh.
Rav amar: bemakdish perot shovacho umardu, ushemuel amar: bemakdish tarnegolto levedek habbayit.
Bishlama shemuel lo amar kerav, deka mokem la bekodshe bedek habbayit, ella rav may tama la amar kishmuel?

Amar lecha rav: davka kafatri mishshilluach, kegon perot shovacho dekodshe mizbeach ninhu, dechevan dekadshi kedushshat hagguf – la paka kedushetayyhu minnayyhu, aval bemakdish tarnegolto levedek habbayit, delav kodshe mizbeach, dikdushshat damim bealma hu – kevan dimrada pekaa kedushetayyhu, vechayyevet beshilluach.

Ushemuel amar: kol hecha deiteh – beve gazza derachamana iteh, dichtiv: "laAdonai haaretz umeloah". vechen amar rabbi yochanan bemakdish tarnegolto levedek habbayit umarda. amar leh rabbi shimon ben lakish: vechevan shemmarda pekaa lay kedusheta! amar leh: beve gazza derachamana ita, dichtiv: "laAdonai haaretz umeloah".
Uremi derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan, uremi derabbi shimon ben lakish adderabbi shimon ben lakish.

Deittemar: mane ze levedek habbayit, venignevu o neevdu – rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv beachrayutan ad sheyyavou lide gizbar, veresh lakish amar: kol hecha deiteh beve gazza derachamana iteh, dichtiv: "laAdonai haaretz umeloah". kashya deresh lakish adderesh lakish, kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan.
Deresh lakish adderesh lakish la kashya, ha mikkamme deshameh merabbi yochanan rabbeh, ha levatar deshameh merabbi yochanan rabbeh.
Ella derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan kashya! derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan name la kashya, ha deamar "alay", ha deamar "hare zo".
Mikkelal derabbi shimon ben lakish, af al gav deamar "alay", la mechayyev?

Vehatanya: ezehu neder veezo hi nedava? neder – haomer "hare alay ola", nedava – haomer "hare zo ola". uma ben neder lindava? neder – meta o nigneva o sheavda, chayyayv beachrayutah; nedava – meta o nigneva o sheavda, eno chayyayv beachrayutah.
Amar lach resh lakish: hane mille kodshe mizbeach, dimchussar hakerava, aval kodshe bedek habbayit, delav mechussar hakerava – af al gav deamar "alay" – la mechayyev.

Vehatnan: haomer "shor ze ola", "bayit ze korban" – met hashshor, nafal habbayit – eno chayyayv beachrayutan; "shor ze alay ola", "bayit ze alay korban" – met hashshor venafal habbayit – chayyayv leshallem.
Hane mille hecha demet hashshor venafal habbayit, chayyayv leshallem, deletanhu, aval hecha deitanhu, kol hecha deiteh beve gazza derachamana iteh, dichtiv "laAdonai haaretz umeloah".
Amar rav hamenuna: hakkol modim baarachin, af al gav deamar "alay" – la michayyayv. may tama? dela mittemar leh bela "alay".
Hechi lema? lema "erki" – amman? lema "erech peloni" – amman?

Matkef la rava: lema "hareni beerki", "hareni beerech peloni"! veod, tanya rabbi natan omer: "venatan et haerkecha bayyom hahu kodesh laAdonai" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shemmatzinu behekdeshot umaasrot shemmitchallelin al maot shebbachullin, nignevu o sheavdu – enan chayyayvin beachrayutan,
b: Yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar: "venatan et haerkecha vegomer" – chullin ad sheyyavou lide gizbar.
Ella, i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rav hamenuna: hakkol modim baarachin, deaf al gav dela amar "alay" – michayyayv, dichtiv "venatan et haerkecha", chullin hen beyadcha ad sheyyavou lide gizbar.
Chomer bechissuy vechulei. tanu rabbanan, "ki yikkare kan tzippor lefanecha" – ma talmud lomar?
Lefi shenneemar "shalleach teshallach et haem veet habbanim tikkach lach", yachol yachzor beharim ugevaot kede sheyyimtza ken? talmud lomar "ki yikkare" – bimora lefanecha.

"Kan" – [ken] mikkol makom, "tzippor" – tehora velo temea, "lefanecha" – birshut hayyachid, "badderech" – birshut harabbim, bailanot minnayin? talmud lomar "bechol etz", bevorot shichin umearot minnayin? talmud lomar "o al haaretz".

Vechi meachar shessofenu lerabbot kol davar, "lefanecha badderech" lema li? lomar lach: ma derech sheen kinno beyadecha, af kol sheen kinno beyadecha. mikkan amru: yone shovach veyone aliyyay shekkinnenu bitfichin uvevirot, vaavavzin vetarnegolin shekkinnenu bappardes – chayyayv beshilluach, aval kinnenu betoch habbayit, vechen yone haredasiyyaot – patur mishshilluach.
Amar mar: ma "derech" – sheen kinno beyadcha, af kol sheen kinno beyadcha. ha lema li? mikki yikkare" nafka, "ki yikkare" perat limzumman. veod, "lefanecha" lema li?

Ella "lefanecha", leetoye shehayu lefanecha umardu, "badderech" – kidrav yehuda amar rav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: matza ken bayyam chayyayv beshilluach, shenneemar "ko amar Adonai hannoten bayyam darech vegomer".
Ella meatta, matza ken bashshamayim, dichtiv "derech nesher bashshamayim", hachi name demichayyayv beshilluach hakken? "derech nesher" ikkeri, "derech" setama la ikkeri.
Amri leh pappunae lerav matna: matza ken berosho shel adam mahu? amar [lehu]: "vaadama al rosho". moshe min hattora minnayin? "beshaggam hu basar".
Haman min hattora minnayin? "hamin haetz".
Ester min hattora minnayin? "veanochi haseter astir". mordochay min hattora minnayin? dichtiv: "mor deror", umetargeminan: "mera dachya".

Veezehu sheeno mezumman vechulei. rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon – chad tane "hadderasiyyaot", vechad tane "haredasiyyaot". man detane "haredasiyyaot" – al shem hordos, uman detane "hadderasiyyaot" – al shem mekoman.

Amar rav kahana: ledidi chazyayn [li], vekayyman shittesar dare bifte mila, (vahava kara) [veamran] "kiri, kiri", (hava chad minnayyhu dela hava kare kiri kiri) [havavt chada dela havavt yada lememar], amara la chaverta: soma, emari "kiri, kiri", amara: soma, emari "kiri kiri", atyuha veshachtuha.
Amar rav ashe: amar li [rabbi] chanina: millin. millin salka datach? ella ema: bemillin.

Of tame patur milleshalleach. menahane mille? amar rabbi yitzchak: deamar kera "ki yikkare ken tzippor lefanecha", of mashma lan ben tahor ben tame. "tzippor" – tahor ashkechan deikkeri "tzippor", tame la ashkechan deikkeri "tzippor".
Ta shema: "tavnit kol tzippor kanaf", may lav "tzippor" – ben tahor ben tame, "kanaf" – chagavim? la, "tzippor" – tahor, "kanaf" – tame vachagavim.
Ta shema: "hachayya vechol behema remes vetzippor kanaf", may lav "tzippor" – ben tahor ben tame, vechanaf" – chagavim? la, "tzippor" – tahor, "kanaf" – tame vachagavim.
Ta shema: "kol tzippor kol kanaf", may lav kidmakshinan? la, kedimshannenan.
Ta shema: "veatta ven adam emor letzippor kol kanaf", may lav kidakshinan? la, kidshannenan.
Ta shema:

a: "Uveanfohi yeduran tzippere shemayya" – "tzippere shemayya" ikkero, "tzippere" setama la ikkero.
Ta shema: "kol tzippor tehora", mikkelal deikka temea? la, mikkelal deikka asura.
May hi? i terefa – behedya ketiv! vei bishchuta dimtzora – missefa dikra nafka, "veze asher lo tochlu mehem" – lerabbot shechutat metzora.
Leolam bishchuta dimtzora, velaavor alav baase uvelo taase. velokma bitrefa, velaavor alav baase velo taase? davar hallamed meinyano, uveinyana dishchuta ketiv.
Ta shema: "shete tzipporim chayyot", may "chayyot"? lav shechayyot befich? mikkelal deikka lav shechayyot befich! la, may "chayyot"? shechayyin rashe evarim shellahen.
Ta shema missefa: "tehorot", mikkelal deikka temeot? la, mikkelal deikka terefot.

Terefot mechayyot" nafka. hanicha leman deamar terefa chayya, ella leman deamar terefa enah chayya, may ikka lememar? veod, ben leman deamar terefa chayya, ben leman deamar enah chayya, middetana deve rabbi yishmael nafka.
Detana deve rabbi yishmael: neemar machshir umechapper bifnim, veneemar machshir umechapper bachutz.
Ma machshir umechapper haamur bifnim – asa bo machshir kimchapper, af machshir umechapper haamur bachutz – asa bo machshir kimchapper.
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lemaote tzippore ir hanniddachat. lemay? i leshilluach – lo amra tora shallach letakkala, ella lishchita.
Rava amar: lemaote shello lezavvevg lah acheret kodem shillucheha. lemay? i lishchita – ha baaya shilluach! ella leshilluach.

Rav pappa amar: letzipporim (shehechlifu) [shehechlifan] betzippore avoda zara, dichtiv: "vehayita cherem kamohu", kol ma sheatta mehayye hemennu kamohu. lemay? i leshilluach – lo amra tora shallach letakkala, ella lishchita.

Ravina amar: hacha bemay askinan? beof sheharag et hannefesh. hechi dame? i digmar dine – bar ketala hu! ella kodem gemar dine, ulemay? i leshilluach – bae leetoye leve dina vekayyome "uviarta hara mikkirbecha"! ella lishchita.
Of tame rovetz al betze of tahor. bishlama of tame rovetz al betze tahor – baenan "tzippor" velekka, ella of tahor rovetz al betze of tame – ha "tzippor" hu!
Kidamar rav kahana: "tikkach lach" – velo lichlavecha, hacha name: "tikkach lach" – velo lichlavecha.
Vehecha ittemar derav kahana? aha detanya: im terefa – chayyayv beshilluach, efrochim terefot – patur mishshilluach. mena hane mille? amar rav kahana: deamar kera "tikkach lach" – velo lichlavecha.
Ulehakkish em terefa leefrochim, ma efrochim terefot – patur mishshilluach, af em terefa name – patur milleshalleach.
b: Im ken, "tzippor" lemaote of tame lema li?
Vehatanya: em efrochin terefa – chayyayv beshilluach! amar abbaye: hachi kaamar – efroach sheimman terefa chayyayv beshilluach.
Bae rav hoshaya: hoshit yado lakken, veshachat miut simanim, mahu?
Mi amrinan: kevan deillu shavek lehu mittarfi, baenan "lach velo lichlavecha", o dilma, kevan divyado lemigmar shechita, "tikkach lach" karena beh, vechayyayv beshilluach? teku.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: matlet mahu shettachotz? kenafayim mahu sheyyachotztzu?
Betzim muzarot, mahu? shene sidre vetzim zo al gav zo, mahu? zachar al gabbe vetzim unekeva al gabbe zachar, mahu? teku.
Bae rabbi zera: yona al betze tasil, mahu? tasil al betze yona, mahu?
Amar abbaye: ta shema, of tame rovetz al betze of tahor, vetahor rovetz al betze of tame – patur mishshilluach. ha tahor vetahor – chayyayv! dilma bekore.

Kore zachar, rabbi eliezer mechayyev vachachamim potrin. amar rabbi avahu: may tama derabbi eliezer? atya "degira" "degira", ketiv hacha "kore dagar velo yalad", uchetiv hatam "uvaka vedagra vetzillah".

Amar rabbi elazar: machloket bekore zachar, aval bekore nekeva – divre hakkol chayyayv. peshita, "kore zachar" tenan! mahu detema rabbanan afillu kore nekeva patri, veha dekatane "zachar" – lehodiacha kocho derabbi eliezer, kamashma lan.

Veamar rabbi elazar: machloket bekore zachar, aval bezachar dealma – divre hakkol patur. peshita, "kore zachar" tenan! mahu detema rabbi eliezer afillu zachar dealma mechayyev, vehay dekatane "kore zachar" – lehodiacha kochan derabbanan, ka mashma lan.
Tanya name hachi: zachar dealma – patur, kore zachar – rabbi eliezer mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.

Mishna hayta meofefet, bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken – chayyayv leshalleach, en kenafeha nogot bakken – patur milleshalleach. en sham ella efroach echad o betza achat – chayyayv leshalleach, shenneemar "kan", ken mikkol makom.

Hayu sham efrochim mafrichim, o betzim muzarot – patur milleshalleach, shenneemar "vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim o al habbetzim", ma efrochim bene kayyayma, af betzim bene kayyayma, yatzu muzarot. uma habbetzim tzerichin leimman, af haefrochin tzerichin leimman, yatzu mafrichin.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "rovetzet" – velo meofefet. yachol afillu kenafeha nogot bakken? talmud lomar "rovetzet". may talmuda? middela ketiv "yoshevet".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hayta yoshevet ben shene rovde ilan – roim, kol sheim tishshamet nofelet alehem – chayyayv leshalleach, veim lav – patur.
Metivi: hayta yoshevet benehen – patur milleshalleach, al gabbehen – chayyayv leshalleach, hayta meofefet, afillu kenafeha nogot bakken – patur milleshalleach.
May lav al gabbehen, dumeya devenehen: ma benehen – denaga behu, af al gabbehen – denaga behu, aval rovde ilan – patur?
Lo, al gabbehen dumeya devenehen: ma benehen – delo naga alayyhu, af al gabbehen – delo naga alayyhu, vehayeynu rovde ilan.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach rovde ilan patur – addetane: hayta meofefet, afillu kenafeha nogot bakken patur milleshalleach, litne rovde ilan, vechol shekken meofefet!
Meofefet itzterich leh, daafillu kenafeha nogot bakken – patur milleshalleach.
Vehaanan tenan: bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken chayyayv leshalleach! amar rabbi yirmeya: ki katane matnita benogea min hatztzad.
Ikka deamri, lema mesayyay leh: hayta yoshevet benehen – patur milleshalleach, al gabbehen – chayyayv leshalleach, hayta meofefet, afillu kenafeha nogot bakken – patur milleshalleach.
May lav al gabbehen, dumeya devenehen: ma benehen – dela naga alayyhu, af al gabbehen – dela naga alayyhu, vehayeynu rovde ilan?
La, al gabbehen dumeya devenehen: ma benehen – denaga behu, af al gabbehen – denaga behu. aval rovde ilan – patur. i hachi, addekatane sefa: hayta meofefet, afillu kenafeha nogot bakken – patur,

a: Litne rovde ilan, vechol shekken meofefet? meofefet itzterich leh, daafillu kenafeha nogot bakken – patur milleshalleach.
Vehaanan tenan: bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken – chayyayv leshalleach! amar rav yehuda: ki katane matnitin – benogea min hatztzad.
En sham efroach vechulei. amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: ema ippecha, en sham efroach ella echad o betza achat – patur milleshalleach, devaenan "efrochim o vetzim" velekka.

Hayu sham efrochim mafrichim o betzim muzarot, chayyayv leshalleach, shenneemar "kan" – ken mikkol makom. im ken, nichtov kera "vehaem rovetzet alehem", may "vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim o al habbetzim"? leakkoshe efrochim levetzim uvetzim leefrochim.

Mishna shillechah vechazra, afillu arbaa vachamishsha peamim – chayyayv, shenneemar: "shalleach teshallach et haem". amar: hareni notel et haem umeshalleach et habbanim – chayyayv, shenneemar: "shalleach teshallach et haem". natal et habbanim vehechziran lah, veachar kach chazra haem alehen – patur milleshalleach.
Gemara amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava, veema: "shalleach" – chada zimna, "teshallach" – tere zimnin.
Amar leh: "shalleach" – afillu mea peamim, "teshallach" – en li ella lidvar harshut, lidvar mitzva minnayin? talmud lomar "teshallach" – mikkol makom.
Amar leh rabbi abba bereh derav yosef bar rava lerav kahana: ella tama dichtav rachamana "teshallach", ha lav hachi, have amena: lidvar mitzva la? ase velo taase hu, veen ase doche lo taase vaase!
La tzericha, daavar veshakla leem, delav avreh, ase hu deikka, lete ase velidche ase, ka mashma lan.
Hanicha leman detane kiyyeymo velo kiyyeymo.
Ella leman detane bittelo velo bittelo, kamma dela shachta – la avreh lelav.
Vetu, lerabbi yehuda deamar "shalleach" meikkara mashma, afillu ase name lekka!
Ella amar mar bar rav ashe: kegon shennetalah al menat leshalleach, delav lekka, ase hu deikka, velete ase velidche ase.
May ulemeh dehay ase mehay ase? salka datach, hoil veamar mar: gadol shalom shebben ish leishto, shehare amra tora: shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu shennichtav bikdushsha yimmache al hammayim.

Vehay metzora, kevan dechamma dela mittahar, asur betashmish hammitta, dichtiv: "veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim", "oholo" – zo ishto, mikkan sheasur betashmish hammitta. mahu detema: kevan deasur betashmish hammitta, lete ase dideh velidche ase deshilluach hakken, ka mashma lan.
Mishna hannotel em al habbanim – rabbi yehuda omer: loke veeno meshalleach, vachachamim omrim: meshalleach veeno loke. ze hakkelal: kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase – en lokin aleha.
Gemara bae rabbi abba bar memel: tama derabbi yehuda mishshum desavar lav shennittak laase lokin alav.
O dilma bealma savar, lav shennittak laase en lokin alav, vehacha hayeynu tama, mishshum dekasavar "shalleach" meikkara mashma.

Ta shema: gannav vegazlan yeshnan bichlal malkot, divre rabbi yehuda. veha hacha, delav shennittak laase hu, derachamana amar "lo tigzol" "veheshiv et haggezela". shema minna tama derabbi yehuda mishshum dekasavar lav shennittak laase lokin alav.
Amar leh rabbi zera: lav amena lechu, kol matnita dela tanya be
b: Rabbi chiyyay uve rabbi oshaya meshabbashta hi, vela totvu minna be midresha, dilma enah bichlal malkot arbaim tanya.
Ta shema, detane rabbi oshaya verabbi chiyyay: "lo tashuv" veshav, "lo techalle" vechilla – yeshnan bichlal malkot arbaim, divre rabbi yehuda.
Shema minna tameh derabbi yehuda, mishshum dekasavar lav shennittak laase – lokin alav.
Dilma hatam hayeynu taam, dekasavar "taazov" meikkara mashma.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ta shema, "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vegomer baesh tisrofu" – ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar lach sheen lokin alav, divre rabbi yehuda.
Shema minna: tama derabbi yehuda mishshum dekasavar "shalleach" meikkara mashma, shema minna.

Amar leh rav idi lerav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: hannotel em al habbanim – rabbi yehuda omer: loke veen meshalleach, vei salka datach tama derabbi yehuda lav shennittak laase lokin alav, "loke umeshalleach" mibbee leh!
Vedilma hachi kaamar bematnitin: en niftar ad demalkin leh.

Ad kamma meshallechah? amar rav yehuda: kede shettetze mittachat yado. bamme meshallechah? rav huna amar: beragleha, rav yehuda amar: baagappeha. rav huna amar beragleha, dichtiv: "meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor". rav yehuda amar baagappeha, deha kenafeha ninhu.
Hahu degazzinhu legappa, veshallecha, veachar kach tafsa. naggedeh rav yehuda. amar leh: zil rabbi la gadfay, veshallecha!
Keman? i kerabbi yehuda – loke veen meshalleach, i kerabbanan – meshalleach veen loke! leolam kerabbanan, umakkat mardut midderabbanan.

Hahu daata lekammeh derava, amar leh: tema mahu? amar: la yada hay gavra deof tahor chayyayv leshalloche? amar leh: dilma chada beata hu deramya? amar leh: (hay yadi) [in. amar leh: may tibbee] lach? matnitin hi: en sham ella efroach echad o vetza achat – chayyayv leshalleach.
Shalcha, veahdar la rava peristake vetafsa. velechush lachashada? kilachar yad.
Tanu rabbanan: yone shovach veyone aliyyay – chayyayvot beshilluach, vaasurot mishshum gazel mippene darche shalom.
Vei ita leha deamar rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina, chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato, keri kan "ki yikkare" – perat limzumman!
Amar (202) [rabba]: betza – im yetziat rubbah hu deichayyayv beshilluach, mikna la kane ad detippol lachatzero, vechi katane chayyayvot beshilluach – mikkamme detippol lachatzero.
I hachi, ammay asurot mishshum gazel? aimmam. veibbaet ema: leolam abbetza, uvetza kevan dinfak leh rubba – dateh aleh.

Vehasheta deamar rav yehuda amar rav: asur lizkot bevetzim shehaem rovetzet alehen, shenneemar: "shalleach et haem" vahadar "habbanim tikkach lach". afillu tema af al gav dinfal lachatzero, kol hecha deihu matze zache – chatzero name zachya, vechol hecha deihu la matze zache – chatzero name la zachya leh.
I hachi, ammay asurot mippene darche shalom? i deshallecha – gazel mealleya hu, i dela shallecha – shalloche bae!
Bekatan. katan bar darche shalom hu? hachi kaamar: aviv shel katan chayyayv lehachezir lo, mippene darche shalom.
Levi bar simon akni perot shovacho lerav yehuda. ata lekammeh dishmuel, amar leh: zil terof akkan, delitgavhu ukeninhu.
Lemay? i lemikne – lakninhu leh besudar! i beyom tov –

a: Beomed veomer "ze veze ani notel" saggi! hanhu pere chadte havo, delevi bar simon gufeh la hava kane lehu, vehachi kaamar leh: zil uterof akkan, delitgavhu venikninhu levi bar simon, vahadar laykninhu nihalach besudar.
Mishna lo yittol adam em al banim, afillu letaher et hametzora. uma im mitzva kalla, shehi keissar, amra tora "lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim", kal vachomer al mitzvot chamurot shebbattora.

Gemara tanya, rabbi yaakov omer: en lecha kol mitzva umitzva shebbattora shemmattan secharah betziddah, sheen techiyyayt hammetim teluya bah. bechibbud av vaem ketiv: "lemaan yaarichun yamecha ulemaan yitav lach", beshilluach hakken ketiv: "lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim".

Hare sheamar lo aviv: ale labbira vehave li gozalot! veala, veshillach et haem velakach et habbanim, uvachazarato nafal vamet. hechan arichut yamav shel ze? vehechan tovato shel ze? ella "lemaan yaarichun yamecha" – beolam shekkullo aroch, "ulemaan yitav lach" – leolam shekkullo tov.
Vedilma la hava hachi? rabbi yaakov maase chaza! vedilma mehareher baavera hava? machshava raa en hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase.
Vedilma mehareher baavoda zara hava, dichtiv: "lemaan tefos et bet yisrael belibbam", veamar rav acha bar yaakov: zo machshevet avoda zara.

Hachi kaamar: im ita deikka sechar mitzvot behay alma, tahane leh vetaggen aleh dela lete lide hirhur velittazzak, ella sechar mitzvot behay alma lekka. vehaamar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva enan nizzokim! bachazaratam shane.

Vehaamar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva enan nizzokim, lo bahalichatan velo bachazaratan! sullam raua hava, umakom dekavua hezzeka shane, dichtiv: "vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani".

Amar rav yosef: ilmale darsheh acher lehay kera kerabbi yaakov bar beratte – la chata. may chaza? ikka deamri: ki hay maase chaza, veikka deamri: lishshana derabbi chutzepit hameturegman chaza, dahava muttelet baashpa. amar: pe shehefik margaliyyot yilchoch afar?! vehu la yada "lemaan yitav lecha" – beolam shekkullo tov, "ulemaan yaarichun yamecha" – beolam shekkullo aroch.
Hadaran alach shilluach hakken, uselika la massechet chullin.

Mishna hallokeach ubbar chamoro shel nachri, vehammocher lo, af al pi sheeno rashshay, hammishtattef lo, vehamekabbel hemennu, vehannoten lo bekabbala — patur min habbechora, shenneemar: "beyisrael", aval lo baacherim.
Gemara kol hane lema li?
Tzerichi, dei tena lokeach — hava amena mishshum deka mayyte la likdushsha, aval mocher deka mafka la mikkedushsha — ema likneseh, ka mashma lan.
Vehammishtattef lo, lema li? leappoke midderabbi yehuda, deamar: shuttafut goyi chayyevet bivchora, kamashma lan diftura min habbechora.
Vehamekabbel, lema li? mishshum deka bae lemitne vehannoten lo bekabbala.
Vehannoten lo bekabbala, lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veikkar behema deyisrael hi, likneseh, dilma ate leichallofe bivhema achariti, kamashma lan.
Tenan hatam: rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura, ben betira mattir bassus.

Ibbaya lehu: ubbar ma li amar rabbi yehuda? tama derabbi yehuda hatam deshare, mishshum dishvura, ubbar name shavur hu. o dilma: shevura lav hayeynu orcheh, aval ubbar, kevan dehayynu orcheh, lav shavur hu?
Ta shema: vehammocher lo, af al pi sheeno rashshay. vela pelig rabbi yehuda.
Velitamaych, hammishtattef lo, vehamekabbel mimmennu, vehannoten lo bekabbala, dela katane — hachi name dela pelig?
Ella — pelig, vela katane. hacha name — pelig, vela katane.

Ta shema: rabbi yehuda omer, hamekabbel behema min haggoy veyalda — maalin oto beshovvyo, venoten chatzi damav lakkohen. vehannoten lo bekabbala, af al pi sheeno rashshay — konsim oto ad asara bedamav, venoten kol damav lakkohen.
b: May lav aubbar? la, abbehema.

Veha "damav" katane! teni "dameha". veha "noten kol damav lakkohen" katane, vei behema — kohen may avidteh? hacha bemay askinan — kegon deyahev leh behema meabbarta lefattoma, demiggo dekansinan leh abbehema, kansinan leh aubbar.
Amar rav ashe: ta shema, rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura, mippene sheenah yechola lehitrappeot. ha yechola lehitrappeot — asar, veha ubbar name keyachol lehitrappeot dame. shema minna.
Veikka dematne la ammatnitin, vehammocher lo, af al pi sheeno rashshay. lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda, ditnan: rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura!
Afillu tema rabbi yehuda — shevura, lav hayeynu orcheh; ubbar, hayeynu orcheh.

Ta shema: rabbi yehuda omer: hamekabbel behema min haggoy veyalda — maalin oto beshovyo, venoten chatzi damav lakkohen. vehannoten lo bekabbala, af al pi sheeno rashshay — konsin oto ad asara bedamav, venoten kol damav lakkohen. may lav aubbar? la, abbehema.

Veha damav katane! teni "dameha". veha "noten kol damav lakkohen" katane, vei behema — kohen may avidteh? hacha bemay askinan — kegon deyahev behema meabbarta lefattoma, demiggo dekansinan leh abbehema — kansinan leh aubbar.
Amar rav ashe, ta shema: rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura, mippene sheenah yechola lehitrappeot. ha yechola lehitrappeot — asur, vehay name keyachol lehitrappeot dame. shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: machar behema leubbareha, may? tibbee lerabbi yehuda, tibbee lerabbanan.
Tibbee lerabbi yehuda: ad kan la ka share rabbi yehuda ella bishvura, dela atya leichallofe, aval shelema deatya leichallofe — asar.
O dilma, uma shevura difsaka minneh, vechol shekken shelema dela pesaka minneh?
Tibbee lerabbanan: ad kan la kaasri rabbanan ella bishvura, difsaka minneh, aval shelema dela pesaka minneh — sharu.
O dilma: uma shevura dela atya leichallofe — asri, vechol shekken shelema deatya leichallofe.
Vetama derabbanan mishshum hachi hu? vehatanya: amru lo lerabbi yehuda: vahalo marbiin aleha veyoledet! alma mishshum ubbareha hu.
Hachi kaamri leh: tama didan mishshum deatya leichallofe bivhema, ella at, may tama sharet? mishshum deen yechola lehitrappeot, keman dezabbena lishchita dame.
Vahalo marbiin aleha veyoledet, vechevan demarbiin aleha veyoledet — meshahe la!
Vaamar lehu: lichshetteled, delo mekabbelet zachar.
Ta shema, vehannoten lo bekabbala, vela katane: "af al pi sheeno rashshay"!

Velitamaych, hammishtattef lo dela katane, hachi name derashshay? veha amar avu dishmuel: asur leadam sheyyaase shuttafut im haggoy, shemma yitchayyev lo shevua venishba lo beshem avoda zara shello, vehattora amra: "lo yishshama al picha"!
Ella, tena mechira, vehu haddin leshuttafut. hachi name, tena mechira vehu haddin lekabbelanut. umay shena mechira denaket? deikkar mechira hi.

Ta shema: rabbi yehuda omer, hamekabbel behema min haggoy veyalda — maalin oto beshovvyo, venoten chatzi damav lakkohen. vehannoten bekabbala, af al pi sheeno rashshay — konsin oto ad asara bedamav, venoten kol damav lakkohen.
Vachachamim omrim: kol zeman sheyyad haggoy baemtza — petura min habbechora.

a: May lav abbehema? la, aubbar.
Dayka name dekatane: konsin oto ad asara bedamav, shema minna.
Mesayyeya leh leresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: hammocher behema gassa legoy — konsin oto ad asara bedameha.
Davka o lav davka? ta shema, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammocher avdo legoy — konsin oto ad mea bedamav! shane eved, dechol yoma veyoma mafka leh mimmitzvot.
Veikka deamri, amar resh lakish: hammocher behema gassa legoy — konsin oto ad mea bedameha. tenan: vehannoten lo bekabbala, af al pi sheeno rashshay — konsin oto ad asara bedameha!
Mechira — paska minneh, kabbelanut — la paska minneh.
Davka o lav davka? ta shema, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammocher avdo legoy — konsin oto ad asara bedamav! shane eved, dela hadar leh.
Behema may tama? mishshum deka hadra leh, nikneseh tefe chad! ella, eved — milleta dela shechicha hi, vechol milleta dela shechicha la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Vachachamim omrim: kol zeman sheyyad haggoy kulei. amar rabbi yehoshua: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, "kol bechor".
Rabbanan savri: "bechor" — miktzat bechor mashma, ketav rachamana "kol" — ad deikka kulleh. verabbi yehuda savar: "bechor" — kulleh bechor mashma, ketav rachamana "kol" — daafillu kol dehu.
Ibbaet ema, dechulle alma "bechor" rubba mashma, mar savar: "kol" mashma lemalloye ata, umar savar: legaroe ata.
Vechamma tehe shuttafut shel goy, utehe petura min habbechora? amar rav huna: afillu ozno. matkef la rav nachman: velema leh: "shekel oznach vezil"!
Ittemar, rav chisda amar: davar sheose oto nevela, verava amar: davar sheose oto terefa.
Bemay kamippalgi? bitrefa chayya. leman deamar davar sheose oto terefa — kasavar terefa enah chayya, uleman deamar davar sheose oto nevela — aval terefa chayya.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: ha derav huna, verav chisda verava — la peligi, ha bo, ha beimmo.
Amar lehu rav pappa: may shena bo, devaenan "kol bechor" velekka? immo name baenan "kol miknecha tizzachar" velekka! ella, la shena.
Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: may shena minnefalim, deaf al gav delav bene chiyyuta ninhu kadshi, deamar mar: "peter sheger behema" — sheger bivhema!
Hatam, kevan dela arivu behu chullin — karena behu bivhema "kol bechor", hacha, kevan dearivu behu chullin — la karena behu "kol bechor".
Rabbi elazar la al leve midresha, ashkecheh lerabbi assi, amar leh: may amur rabbanan be midresha? amar leh:
b: Hachi amar rabbi yochanan: afillu mum kal. vehaditnan: rachel sheyyalda min ez veez sheyyalda min rachel — petura min habbechora, veim yesh bo miktzat simanin — chayyayv. mum kavua have lishchot alav.
Bishlama mum kal — ka mashma lan kidrav huna, uleappoke midderav chisda verava.
Ella mum kavua — may ka mashma lan? dechevan deishtanni have leh muma? tenena: ufiv dome keshel chazir — hare ze mum!
Vechi tema, hatam nishtanna bedavar sheen bemino kadosh bivchora, hacha nishtanna bedavar shebbemino kadosh bivchora, ha name tenena: eno achat gedola veachat ketanna.

Vetanna gedola — gedola keshel egel, uketanna — ketanna keshel avvavz. bishlama ketanna keshel avvavz, en bemino kadosh bivchora, ella gedola keshel egel — yesh bemino kadosh bivchora! ella lav mishshum deamrinan: kevan deishtanni have leh muma?
La, mishshum dehave leh "sarua". hachi name mistabbera, ditnan: mumin ellu, ben kevuin ben ovrin — poslin. yater alehen adam: enav shetehen gedolot, shetehen ketannot.
Gabbe adam hu dichtiv: "ish ish mizzera aharon", devaenan ish shave bezaro shel aharon, aval behema, shetehen gedolot shetehen ketannot — name la have muma.
Achat gedola veachat ketanna, may tama? i mishshum shinnuy — afillu shetehen gedolot, shetehen ketannot name! ella lav mishshum dehave leh "sarua"?

La, leolam ema lach mishshum shinnuy, shinnuy have muma. udeka kashya lach: afillu shetehen gedolot, shetehen ketannot? hatam, i mechamat beriyyuta yattira — tarvavyyhu bae lemivra, i mechamat kechishuta yattira — tarvavyyhu bae michchash.
Hahi giyyorta dahavo masrin la ache chevta lefattoma, atay lekammeh derava, amar la: let dechash la leha derabbi yehuda, deamar: shuttafut goy chayyevet bivchora.
Rav mari bar rachel haveya leh hahi chevata, hava makne leudenayyhu legoy, veasar lehu begizza vaavoda, veyahev lehu lechohanim, uchelay chevata derav mari bar rachel.

Vechi meachar deasar lehu begiza vaavoda, veyahev lehu lechohanim, ammay makne lehu leudenayyhu legoy, dilma ate behu lide takkala? i hachi, may tama kelo chevata derav mari? mishshum demafka lehu mikkedushetayyhu.

Vehaamar rav yehuda: muttar laadam lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyatza laavir haolam! hatam mikkedushshat mizbeach ka mafka leh, mikkedushshat kohen la mafka leh. hacha afillu mikkedushshat kohen ka mafka leh.
Veibbaet ema: rav mari bar rachel yada leaknoye kinyan gamur, vechaze leh inish acharina, veazel veaved, vesavar rav mari milleta hu daavad, veate bah lide takkala.
Mishna kohanim uleviyyim peturin, mikkal vachomer: im patru et shel yisrael bammidbar, din hu sheyyifteru et shel atzman.

a: Gemara inhu patri?! adam — adam patar, behema — behema patra, dichtiv: "kach et haleviyyim tachat bechor bivne yisrael veet behemat haleviyyim tachat behemtam"!
Amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: kohanim uleviyyim peturin behemtam mikkal vechomer — im hifkia behemtam shel leviyyim behema shel yisrael bammidbar, din hu shettafkia et shel atzman.
Amar leh rava: veha "patru" inhu katane!
Veod, im ita, afillu mibbechor behema tehora nippatru! allema tenan: lo nifteru mibbechor behema tehora, ella mippidyon habben ufeter chamor?
Ella amar rava, hachi katane: kohanim uleviyyim patru hen atzman mikkal vachomer, im hifkia kedushshatan shel leviyyim kedushshat shel yisrael bammidbar, lo yafkia et shel atzman?

Ashkechan adam, behema temea menalan? amar kera: "ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde", kol sheyyeshno bivchor adam — yeshno bivchor behema temea, vechol sheeno bivchor adam — eno bivchor behema temea.
Amar leh rav safra leabbaye: ledidach deamrat behemtam, ben levi dahava leh se deafka — layfka, dela hava leh se delayfka — la layfka!
Ben ledidach, ben lerava, ben chodesh deafka — layfka, pachot mibben chodesh dela afka — la layfka!
Leviyya la tayfka? allema amar rav adda bar ahava: leviyya sheyyalda — benah patur mechamesh selaim?
Ha la kashya, kidmar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava, deamar: "peter rechem" befeter rechem tela rachamana.
Veaharon shello haya beoto minyan — la layfka! detanya: lamma nakud al "aharon" shebbechomesh happekudim — shello haya beoto minyan.
Amar kera: "haleviyyim", hukeshu kol haleviyyim ze laze.
Kohanim menalan? kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beesrim vearbaa mekomot nikreu kohanim "leviyyim", veze echad mehen: "vehakkohanim haleviyyim bene tzadok".
b: Uledorot menalan? amar kera: "vehayu li haleviyyim", "vehayu" — bahavavyaytan yehu.
Umimmay divse? amar rav chisda: neemar kesef ledorot, veneemar se ledorot.
Ma kesef haamur ledorot — bo padu ledorot, bo padu leotah shaa, af se haamur ledorot — bo padu ledorot, bo padu beotah shaa.
Ma lechesef — shachen podin bo hekdeshot umaaser sheni!

Ella, amar kera: "ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde", ma bechor adam lo chillakta ben ledorot ben leotah shaa — bechesef, af behema temea lo tachlok bo ben ledorot ben leotah shaa — bese.
Amar rabbi chanina: se echad shel ben levi patar kamma pitre chamorim miyyisrael. amar abbaye: teda, shehare mana hakkatuv odfim beadam, velo mana odfin bivhema.
Mimmay? dilma la have nefishi lehu behemot tuva? la salka datach! dichtiv: "umikne rav haya livne reuven velivne gad".
Dilma afillu hachi, peshutim dilviyyim havo kayymi levahade bechore yisrael! amar kera: "veet behemat haleviyyim tachat behemtam", behema achat tachat behemot harebe.
Veema behema rabba? im ken, lichtov kera o "behema tachat behema" o "behemtam tachat behemtam"! may "behemat... techat behemtam"? shema minna chad patar tuva.

Amar rava, af anan name tenena: ufode bo peamim harebe. verabbi chanina tama dematnitin mefaresh, vehachi kaamar: may tama pode bo peamim harebe? mishshum dese echad shel ben levi poter kamma pitre chamorim shel yisrael.
Ittemar, rabbi yochanan amar: kadshu bechorot bammidbar, veresh lakish amar: lo kadshu bechorot bammidbar.
Rabbi yochanan amar: kadshu bechorot bammidbar, derachamana amar likdeshu, dichtiv: "kaddesh li chol bechor".
Veresh lakish amar: lo kadshu bechorot bammidbar, middichtiv: "vehaya ki yeviacha", uchetiv batreh: "vehaavarta", mikkelal demeikkara la kedush.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: ad shello hukam hammishkan hayu bamot muttarot vaavoda bivchorot! amar leh: beotan sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi, ben shana bar mebad avoda hu?
Udekaare la, may kaare la?
Hachi ka kashya leh: i amrat bishlama dela pasek kedushetayyhu — hanach demeikkara name la paka kedushetayyhu, ella i amrat defasek kedushetayyhu — hanach demeikkara name paka leh kedushetayyhu.
Veiddach: dikdush — kedush, dela kedush — la kedush.

Etiveh: oto hayyom shehukam hammishkan, karvu bo lahem beyisrael nedarim unedavot, chattaot vaashamot, bechorot umaasrot. hachi name — beotan sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim. uminna: oto hayyom hu dikruv, mikkan veelach la keruv!

Ikka deamri: etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: oto hayyom shehukam hammishkan karvu lahem yisrael nedarim unedavot chattaot vaashamot bechorot umaasrot. oto hayyom — in, mikkan veelach — la! ema: meoto hayyom veelach.
Umay kamashma lan? meoto hayyom — in, meikkara — la. alma chovot bevama la keruv.

Ta shema, nimtzeta atta omer: bishlosha mekomot kadshu bechorot leyisrael — bemitzrayim, uvammidbar, uvichnisatan yisrael leeretz. bemitzrayim mahu omer? "kaddesh li chol bechor". bammidbar hu omer: "ki li chol bechor bivne yisrael". bichnisatam laaretz hu omer: "vehaya ki yeviacha... vehaavarta".
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: bishlosha mekomot huzeharu al habbechorot likdash, velo kadshu. uvemitzrayim name la kedush? ha kaamrinan dikdush! hachi amar: mehen kadshu, umehen lo kadshu.
Matkef la rav pappa: uvammidbar lo kadshu? vehachtiv: "pekod kol bechor zachar livne yisrael"! ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: rabbi yochanan amar: kadshu velo pasku, veresh lakish amar: kadshu

a: Ufasku.
Bishlama resh lakish, kidamar taam, ella lerabbi yochanan — may tama?
Amar rabbi elazar: rabbi yochanan chazay bechelma demilleta meallayta amena, amar kera "li yihyu" — bahavayaytan yehu.
Verabbi yochanan, "vehaya ki yeviacha... vehaavarta" may aved leh? hahu mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael: ase mitzva zo shebbishvilah tikkanes laaretz.
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: attun hachi matnitu la, anan ippecha matninan la, rabbi yochanan amar: lo kadshu bechorot bammidbar, veresh lakish amar: kadshu bechorot bammidbar.
Amar leh: veafchit name teyuvata, veafchitu la leha derabbi elazar? amar leh: lo kadshu lehu — lo hutzerchu likdash.
I hachi, hayeynu didan! ka mashma lan: chayyayv adam lomar bilshon rabbo.
Shaal kunetrukus hassar et rabban yochanan ben zakkay: bifratan shel leviyyim atta motze esrim ushenayim elef ushelosh meot, bichlalan atta motze esrim ushenayim elef, ushelosh meot lehechan halchu?
Amar lo: otan shelosh meot bechorot hayu, veen bechor mafkia bechor. may tama? amar abbaye: dayyo labbechor sheyyafkia kedushshat atzmo.
Veod shealo: begibbuy kesef atta motze matayim veachat kikkar veachat esre mane, dichtiv: "beka laggulgolet machatzit hashshekel beshekel hakkodesh vegomer",

Uvintinat hakkesef atta motze meat kikkar, dichtiv: "vayhi meat kikkar hakkesef latzeket vegomer". moshe rabbechem gannav haya, o kuveyusetus haya, o eno baki becheshbonot? natan mechetza venatal mechetza, umechetza shalem lo hechezir.
Amar lo: moshe rabbenu gizbar neeman haya, uvaki becheshbonot haya, umane shel kodesh kaful haya.
Have ba rav achay: may ka kashya leh, "vayhi meat kikkar hakkesef latzeket vegomer"? hanach latzeket, veinach be gazza! ketav kera acharina: "vechesef pekude haeda meat kikkar vegomer".
Udekaamar leh: mane shel kodesh kaful haya, mena leh?

Ilema minneh, shehare kan shivim veechad mane — "veet haalef usheva meot vachamishsha veshivim asa vavim laammudim", velo menaan hakkatuv ella bifrotrot, veim ita — mea veechad kikkar veachat esre mane mibbee leh!
Ella, middelo menaan hakkatuv ella bifrotrot, shema minna: mane shel kodesh kaful haya.
Vedilma kelale kachashev bechakkere, perati la ka chashev bechakkere!
Ella mehacha: "unechoshet hattenufa shivim kikkar vealpayim vearba meot shakel", shehare kan tishim veshishsha mane, velo menaan hakkatuv ella bifrotrot, shema minna: mane shel kodesh kaful haya.
Vedilma perata rabba ka chashev bechakkere, perata zuta la kachashev bechakkere!
Ella amar rav chisda: mehacha, "vehashshekel esrim gera esrim shekalim chamishsha veesrim shekalim asara vachamishsha shekel hammane yihye lachem".
b: Veha matan vearbein havyayn! ella shema minna: mane shel kodesh mane kaful haya.
Ushema minna, mosifin al hammiddot, veen mosifin yater al shetut, ushema minna shetuta millevar.

Amar rabbi chanina: shaalti et rabbi eliezer bevet motva rabba, ma nishtannu pitre chamorim mippitre susim ugemallim? amar li: gezerat hakkatuv hi, veod shessiyyeyu yisrael bishat yetziatam mimmitzrayim, sheen lach kol echad veechad miyyisrael shello hayu immo tishim chamorim luvim teunim mikkaspah uzehavah shel mitzrayim.

Veod sheiltiv: may leshon "refidim"? veamar li: refidim shemah. ketannae: rabbi eliezer omer: refidim shemah, rabbi yehoshua omer: sherippu atzman middivre tora, vechen hu omer: "lo hifnu avot el banim merifyon yadayim".
Veod sheiltiv: may leshon "shittim"? veamar li: shittim shemah. ketannae: rabbi eliezer omer: shittim shemah, rabbi yehoshua omer: shennitasku bedivre shetut.
"Vattikrena laam lezivche elohehen" — rabbi eliezer omer: arummot pagu bahen, rabbi yehoshua omer: shennaasu kullan baale kerayin.
Mishna para sheyyalda min chamor, vachamor sheyyalda kemin sus — petura min habbechora, shenneemar: "peter chamor" "peter chamor" shene peamim, ad sheyyehe hayyoled chamor vehannolad chamor.
Uma hem baachila? behema tehora sheyyalda kemin behema temea — muttar baachila, utemea sheyyalda kemin behema tehora — asur baachila, shehayyotze min hattame — tame, vehayyotze min hattahor — tahor.
Gemara tenan hatam: rachel sheyyalda min ez, veez sheyyalda min rachel — patur min habbechora, veim yesh bo miktzat simanin — chayyayv.
Mena hane mille? amar rav yehuda, deamar kera: "ach bechor shor" — sheyyehe hu shor uvechoro shor, "bechor kesev" — sheyyehe hu kesev uvechoro kesev, "bechor ez" — sheyyehe hu ez uvechoro ez.
Yachol afillu yesh bo miktzat simanin? talmud lomar: "ach" — chillek.
Veha tanna "peter" "peter" kanasev la, lefara!

Hu deamar kerabbi yose haggelili, detanya: rabbi yose haggelili omer: "ach bechor shor" — ad sheyyehe hu shor uvechoro shor, "bechor kesev" — ad sheyyehe hu kesev uvechoro kesev, "o vechor ez" — ad sheyyehe hu ez uvechoro ez.
Yachol afillu yesh bo miktzat simanin? talmud lomar: "ach" — chillek.
Bemay kamippalgi? tanna didan savar: galli rachamana bikdushshat damim, vehu haddin bikdushshat hagguf.
Verabbi yose savar: galli rachamana bikdushshat hagguf, vehu haddin bikdushshat damim, vegamar kedushshat damim mikkedushshat hagguf.
Vetanna didan, hay "bechor" "bechor" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina.
Deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: lamma neemru emurin bivchor shor, emurin bivchor kesev, emurin bivchor ez?
Tzericha, dei ketav rachamana bivchor shor — shekken nitrabba binsachim.
Kesev — shekken nitrabba bealya.
Beez — shekken nitrabba etzel avoda zara beyachid.
Chada mechada la atya, tete chada mittarte!
Behe la lichtov? la lichtov rachamana beshor, vetete mehanach — ma lehanach, shekken nitrabbu etzel pesachim!
La lichtov bechesev, vetete mehanach — ma lehanach shekken nitrabbu etzel avoda zara betzibbur!
La nichtov rachamana beez, vetete mehanach — ma lehanach shekken yesh bahen tzad ribbuy etzel mizbeach! hilkach tzerichi.
Verabbi yose haggelili, im ken lichtov kera "ach bechor shor kesev veez", "bechor" "bechor" lema li? ella lav shema minna: ad sheyyehe hu shor uvechoro shor.
Verabbi yose haggelili, hay "peter chamor" "peter chamor" may aved leh?

Mibbee leh lechidtanya: rabbi yose haggelili omer, mittoch shenneemar "ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde", shomea ani afillu pitre susim ugemallim? talmud lomar "peter chamor" — peter chamor amarti lecha, velo pitre susim ugemallim.
Vaadayin ani omer: pitre chamor bese, pitre susim ugemallim bechol davar.

a: Talmud lomar: "peter chamor" "peter chamor" shene peamim — pitre chamorim amarti lecha, velo pitre susim ugemallim.
Parech rav achay: i ketav rachamana chad, hava amena davar shehaya bakkelal, veyatza min hakkelal lelammed, lo lelammed al atzmo yatza ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza, uleolam bese.
Ketav rachamana "peter chamor" acharina, pitre chamorim velo pitre susim ugemallim, veema: maatinhu moshe, uleolam bechol davar!
Im ken, lichtov rachamana: "peter chamor tifde vese" vachamor tifde vese". "peter chamor tifde vese", "peter chamor tifde vese" lema li? pitre chamorim amarti lecha, velo pitre susim ugemallim.
Vetanna didan, lemaote susim ugemallim, mena leh?
Amar rav pappa: kol miknecha tizzachar — kalal, shor vase vachamor — parat, kelal uferat — en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat, shor vase vachamor — in, midde acharina — la.
Verabbi yose haggelili? "peter" hifsik hainyan, verabbanan? vav hadar arveh kera.
Verabbi yose haggelili? la lichtov la vav vela "peter".
Verabbanan? ayyeyde deha kedushshat damim, veha kedushshat hagguf — pasek lehu vahadar arev lehu.
Ibbaya lehu: para sheyyalda min chamor, veyesh bo miktzat simanin — mahu?
Ez sheyyalda min rachel, verachel sheyyalda min ez, dechi yesh miktzat simanin — chayyevet bivchora, deha tehora veha tehora, ha kedushshat hagguf veha kedushshat hagguf.
Hacha, deha temea veha tehora, ha kedushshat hagguf veha kedushshat damim — la, o dilma: kevan deidde veidde bene mikdash bivchora — kadosh?
Veim timtze lomar: kevan deidde veidde mikdash bivchora kadosh, chamor sheyyalda min sus mahu? hacha vadday la bat mikdash bivchora hu, o dilma kevan demin temea hu kadosh?
Im timtza lomar: kevan demin temea hu kadosh, para sheyyalda min sus mahu? hacha vadday ha tehora veha temea, ha bat mikdash bivchora veha la bat mikdash bivchora, o dilma simanin milleta hi?
Ta shema: behema tehora sheyyalda min behema temea — petura min habbechora, im yesh bo miktzat simanin — chayyevet bivchora. may lav afillu para sheyyalda min sus? lo, para sheyyalda min chamor.
Ta shema: para sheyyalda min chamor, vachamor sheyyalda min sus — petura min habbechora, im yesh bo miktzat simanin — chayyevet bivchora. may lav attarvayyhu? la, appara sheyyalda min chamor.

Aval chamor sheyyalda min sus, lemay katane la? liftura? peshita! hasheta, uma para sheyyalda min chamor, deidde veidde bene mikdash bivchora ninhu, amrat: im yesh bo miktzat simanin — in, vei la — la, chamor sheyyalda min sus mibbaya?
Itzterich, salka datach: hatam hu deyesh lah karnayim, veha en lah karnayim; ha parsoteha sedukot, veha parsoteha kelutot.
Aval hacha, deidde veidde en lah karnayim, idde veidde parsoteha kelutot, ema chamor adom bealma hu, kamashma lan.
Uma hen baachila kulei. lema li lemitne "shehayyotze"?
Simana bealma hu, dela tichallaf lach, dela tema: zil batreh dideh, vehay tahor mealleya hu, vehay tame mealleya hu, ella zil batar immeh.

Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ach et ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa" — yesh lecha shehu maale gera umafris parsa vei atta ochlo, veeze ze? tahor shennolad min hattame. o eno ella tame hannolad min hattahor, umay "mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa"?
b: Hachi kaamar: davar habba mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa la techul, talmud lomar: "gamal... tame hu" — hu tame, veen tame hannolad min hattahor tame ella tahor.
Rabbi shimon omer: "gamal" "gamal" shene peamim, echad gamal hannolad min haggemalla, veechad gamal hannolad min happara.
Verabbanan, hay "gamal" "gamal" may avdi leh? chad leesor atzmo, vechad leesor chalavo. verabbi shimon, leesor chalavo mena leh? nafka leh meet haggamal". verabbanan, "ettim" la darshi.

Kidtanya: shimon haamsoni haya doresh kol "et" vaet" shebbattora, kevan shehiggia leet Adonai elohecha tira" perash. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, kol "ettin" sheddarashta ma tehe alehem? amar lahem: keshem shekkibbolti sachar al hadderisha, kach ani mekabbel sachar al happerisha.
Ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed: "et Adonai elohecha tira" — lerabbot talmide chachamim.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: ella meatta, tama derabbanan miggamal" "gamal", verabbi shimon meet haggamal", ha lav hachi hava amena chalav divhema temea shere?
May shena meha detanya: "hattemeim" — leesor tziran, verotvan, vekefe shellahen?
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil divhema tehora name chiddush hu, deamar mar: dam nekar venaase chalav, vechevan dechiddush hu — bivhema temea name lishtere, ka mashma lan.
Hanicha leman deamar dam nekar venaase chalav, ella leman deamar evareha mitparkin hemenna veen nafshah chozeret aleha ad esrim vearbaa chodesh, may ikka lememar?
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil velekka midde deate mechay vesharyeh rachamana, vehay chalav ki ever min hachay hu, ushere, vehilkach afillu bivhema temea lishtere, ka mashma lan.
Vechalav divhema tehora menalan dishre? ilema middaasar rachamana "basar bechalav", ha lechudeh shere, veema: chalav lechudeh asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, basar bechalav — bahanaa name asur!
Ulerabbi shimon, deshare bahanaa, mashkachat la lemilke al bishshuleh!
Ella middegalli rachamana devifsule hammukedashin, "tizbach" — velo gizza, "basar" — velo chalav, ha dechullin shere.
Veema: dechullin asur baachila ushere bahanaa, dekadashim bahanaa name asur!
Ella, middichtiv: "vede chalev izzim lelachmecha lelechem betecha vechayyim lenaarotecha".
