Vedilma lischora? ella middichtiv "veet aseret charitze hechalav".
Vedilma lischora? attu darkah shel milchama lischora?!

Veibbaet ema mehacha: "eretz zavat chalav udevash", vei la dishre, mishtabbach lan kera bemidde dela chaze? veibbaet ema mehacha: "lechu shivru veecholu, ulechu shivru belo chesef uvelo mechir yayin vechalav".
Ella meatta, "shafan" "shafan", "arnevet" "arnevet", "chazir" "chazir", lehane hu deatu?
Ella lechidtanya: lamma nishnu babbehema — mippene "hashshesua", uvaofot — mippene "haraa".
"Gamal" "gamal" name lehachi hu daata! kol hecha deikka lemidrash darshinan.
Tanu rabbanan: rachel sheyyalda min ez, veez sheyyalda min rachel — petura min habbechora, veim yesh bo miktzat simanim — chayyevet. rabbi shimon omer: ad sheyyehe rosho verubbo dome leimmo.
Ibbaya lehu: laachila, mi bae rabbi shimon rosho verubbo, o la?
Leinyan bechora, ketiv: "ach bechor shor", ad sheyyehe hu shor uvechoro shor. aval laachila, gamal hu deamar rachamana daasir, ha

a: Ishtanni miggamal shappir dame, o dilma la shena?
Ta shema: behema tehora sheyyalda min behema temea — asur baachila, veim dome rosho verubbo leimmo — chayyayv bivchora. shema minna: laachila name bae rabbi shimon rosho verubbo!
La, livchora davka. dayka name, deka shavka laachila vekam leh abbechor. shema minna: livchora hu devae rabbi shimon rosho verubbo, aval laachila — la.

Leolam ema lach: laachila name bae, uvechora itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "ach bechor shor", ad sheyyehe hu shor uvechoro shor, velo tisge leh berosho verubbo ad deikka kulleh, kamashma lan.
Ta shema: "ach et ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa", ze — i atta ochel, aval atta ochel habba besiman echad.
Vei ze ze habba besiman echad? ze tame hannolad min hattahor, veibburo min hattahor.
Yachol afillu ibburo min hattame? talmud lomar: "se chesavim vese izzim", ad sheyyehe aviv keves veimmo kivsa, divre rabbi yehoshua.

Rabbi eliezer omer: lo ba hakkatuv lehattir et hammuttar, ella lehosif al hammuttar, veeze ze? tame hannolad min hattahor veibburo min hattame. o eno ella ibburo min hattahor? talmud lomar: "shor se chesavim vese izzim" mikkol makom.
Kare leh "tame", kerabbi shimon, vekaamar: aval atta ochel habba besiman echad!
Hay tanna savar leh kevavteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Veikka demakshe umotev: ibburo min hattame — mi miabbera?

Vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: leolam en mitabberet lo temea min hattahor, velo tehora min hattame, velo gassa min haddakka, velo dakka min haggassa, velo behema min chayya, velo chayya min behema.
Chutz merabbi eliezer umachluketo, shehayu omrim chayya mitabberet mibbehema!
Veamar rabbi yirmeya: deiabbar mikkalut ben para, veallibba derabbi shimon kaamar, vekaamar: aval atta ochel habba besiman echad!
Hay tanna savar la kevavteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Lememra, derabbi eliezer savar: ze vaze gorem — muttar, verabbi yehoshua savar: ze vaze gorem — asur?
Veha ippecha shaminan lehu: velad terefa, rabbi eliezer omer: lo yikrav legabbe mizbeach, verabbi yehoshua omer: yikrav legabbe mizbeach!
Bealma savar rabbi eliezer: ze vaze gorem — asur, veshane hacha, deim ken nichtov kera: "se chesavim veizzim", "se" "vese" lema li? shema minna: se — mikkol makom.
Verabbi yehoshua amar lecha: bealma ze vaze gorem — muttar, vehacha im ken lichtov kera: "shor kesev vaez", "kesavim veizzim" lema li? shema minna ad sheyyehe aviv keves veimmo kivsa.
Ta shema: rabbi shimon omer, "gamal" "gamal" shene peamim — echad gamal hannolad min haggamal, veechad gamal hannolad min happara, veim rosho verubbo dome leimmo — muttar baachila.
Shema minna, laachila name bae rabbi shimon rosho verubbo, shema minna.
Shehayyotze min hattame vechulei. beo minna merav sheshet: me raglayim shel chamor, mahu?

Vetibbee leh desusim ugemallim? desusim ugemallim la mibbaya lehu, dela achiri vela damu lechalav, mayya ul mayya nefuk. ki kamibbaya lehu dachamor, daachiri vedamu lechalav, may? miggufeh ka mimmatztzi vaasiri, o dilma mayya ul mayya nefuk, vehay daachiri — havela devisra hu?
Amar lehu rav sheshet, tenetu: shehayyotze min hattame — tame, vehayyotze min hattahor — tahor. "mittame" la kaamar, ella "min
b: Hattame", vehane name mina detame hu.
Veikka deamri, desusim ugemallim la ka mibbaya lehu, dela shatu inashe. ki kamibbaya lehu dachamor, deshatu inashe umeallu leyarkona, may?
Amar lehu rav sheshet, tenetuha: hayyotze min hattame tame, vehayyotze min hattahor tahor — vehane name mittame kaate.
Metivi: mippene ma amru devash devorim muttar? mippene shemmachnisot oto legufan, veen mematztzot oto miggufan.
Hu deamar kerabbi yaakov, deamar: duvesha rachamana sharyeh.
Detanya, rabbi yaakov omer: "ach et ze tochlu mikkol sheretz haof" — ze atta ochel, vei atta ochel sheretz of tame.
Sheretz of tame behedya ketiv! ella sheretz of tame i atta ochel, aval atta ochel ma sheof tame mashritz, veeze ze? ze devash devorim.

Yachol af devash haggazzin vehatztzirin? amarta: lo. uma raita lerabbot devorim, ulehotzi haggazzin vehatztzirin? merabbe ani devash devorim sheen lo shem levavy, umotzi ani devash haggazzin vehatztzirin sheyyesh lo shem levavy.
Keman azla ha detanya: devash haggazzin vehatztzirin tahor umuttar baachila? dela kerabbi yaakov.
Tahor — alma bae machshava. tanya name hachi: devash bechavvavrto metamme tumeat ovchalin shello bemachshava.
Chale deyachmureta, sevur rabbanan lememar: bee ninhu vaasiran. amar rav safra: zara deayyala hu, deazel batar ayyalta, veayyeyde derachmah tzar la mizdakka, veazel batar yachmureta venatri.
Amar rav huna: or habba keneged panav shel chamor — muttar, may tama? pirsha bealma hu.
Amar leh rav chisda: tanya dimsayya lach: or habba keneged panav shel adam, ben chay ben met — tahor. may lav ben hu chay veimmo chayya, ben hu met veimmo meta?
La, ben hu chay veimmo meta, ben hu met veimmo chayya. vehatanya: ben hu chay veimmo chayya, ben hu met veimmo meta! i tanya, tanya.
Mishna dag tame shebbala dag tahor, muttar baachila, vetahor shebbala dag tame, asur baachila, lefi sheeno giddulo.
Gemara tama dachazeneh divla, ha la chazeneh divla — amri: ashrotze ashretz.
Menalan? detanya: dag tame mashritz, dag tahor metil betzim. i hachi, ki chazena divla amrinan: hay iakkala, vehay ashrotze ashretz!
Amar rav sheshet: kegon shemmetzao derech harei. rav pappa amar: kegon shemmetzao derech bet habbelia. rav nachman amar: kegon shemmetzao shalem.
Rav ashe amar: rov dagim beminan mashritzin, uchemi shebbala lefanenu dame.
Tanu rabbanan: dag tame — mashritz, dag tahor — metil betzim, kol hammolid — menik, vechol hammetil betzim — melakket, chutz meatallef sheaf al pi shemmetil betzim — menik.

a: Haddolfanin parin veravin kivne adam. may dolfanin? amar rav yehuda: bene yamma.
Kol shebbetzav mibbachutz — molid, vechol shebbifnim — metil betzim.
Ini? vehaamar shemuel: avavz vaavavz bar kilayim ze baze, vehavenan bah: may tama? amar abbaye: ze betzav mibbachutz, veze betzav mibbifnim, vetarvayyhu metile betzim!
Ella, kol shezzachruto mibbachutz — molid, mibbifnim — metil betzim.
Kol shettashmisho bayyom — yoled bayyom, ballayla — yoled ballayla, kol shettashmisho ben bayyom ben ballayla — yoled ben bayyom ben ballayla.
Tashmisho bayyom yoled bayyom — tarnegol, ballayla yoled ballayla — atallef, tashmisho ben bayyom ben ballayla yoled ben bayyom ben ballayla — adam vechol dedame leh.

Lemay nafka minna? lechidrav mari bereh derav kahana, deamar rav mari bereh derav kahana: badak bekinna shel tarnegolin meerev yom tov velo matza bah betza, ulemachar hishkim umatza vah betza — mutteret baachila beyom tov, emar: lo badak yafe.
Vahalo badak yafe! emar: yatzta rubbah vechazra hava, vechidrabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: betza sheyyatzta rubbah meerev yom tov vechozeret — mevutteret leochlah beyom tov.
Kol shettashmisho veibburo shave — yoldim umegaddelim ze mizze. hakkol meshammeshin panim keneged oref, chutz mishshelosha shemmeshammeshin panim keneged panim, veellu hen: dag, veadam, venachash.
Umay shena hane telata? ki ata rav dimi amri bemareva: hoil vedibbera immahem shechina.
Tana: gamal — achor keneged achor.

Tanu rabbanan: tarnegolet — leesrim veechad yom, uchenegdah bailan — luz, kelev — lachamishshim yom, uchenegdo bailan — teena, chatul — lachamishshim ushenayim yom, uchenegdo bailan — tut, chazir — leshishshim yom, kenegdo bailan — tappuach, shual vechol mine sheratzim — shishsha chodashim, uchenegdam bailan — tevua.

Behema dakka tehora — lachamishsha chodashim, uchenegdan bailan — gefen. behema gassa temea — lishnem asar chodesh, uchenegdo bailan — dekel. tehora — letisha chodashim, uchenegdah bailan — zayit. hazzeev vehaari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehappil vehakkof vehakkifof — leshalosh shanim, uchenegdan bailan — benot shuach.

Efe leshivim shana, uchenegdo bailan — charuv. charuv ze, mishsheat netiato ad sheat gemar perotav — shivim shana, vime ibburo shalosh shanim. nachash lesheva shanim, uleoto rasha lo matzinu chaver. veyesh omrim: mochsasim.

Mena hane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav, umatu bah mishshum derabbi yehoshua ben chananya, shenneemar: "arur atta mikkol habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade". im mibbehema nitkallela, mechayya lo kol shekken?
Ella, lomar lach: keshem shennitkallela habbehema mechayya, echad leshiva, umay nihu? chamor mechatul, kach nitkallel hu mibbehema, achat lesheva, dehave leh shav shene.
Ema: keshem shennitkallela chayya mibbehema, achat leshalosh shanim, umay nihu? ari mechamor, kach nitkallel hu mechayya achat leshalosh shanim, dehave leh tesha shanim.
b: Mi ketiv "mikkol hachayya umikkol habbehema"? "mikkol habbehema umikkol hachayya" ketiv! arur hu mibbehema shennitkallela mechayya.
Veema: keshem shennitkallela behema mechayya echad leshalosh, umay nihu? ez mechatul, kach nitkallel hu mibbehema echad leshalosh, dehave leh chamesar yarche!
Ibbaet ema: "mikkol habbehema" ketiv. i baet ema: kelala hu, kelala shedi illaveh.

Amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: nachash lechamma miabbar umoled? amar leh: leshav shene. veha save deve attuna arbeinhu, veolid litlat! hanhu miabberi havo meikkara arba. veha kamshammeshi shammoshe! inhu name meshammeshi keadam.
Veha chakkime inhu? anan chachiminan minnayyhu. i chachimat, zil zakkinhu veaytinhu li! amar leh: kamma havu? shittin gavre.

Amar leh: aved li sefinta deit ba shittin batte, vechol beta it ba shittin bistarke. avad leh. ki meta lehatam leve tabbacha, ashkecheh lehahu gavra deka fashet chevta. amar leh: reshach lezabbone? amar leh: in. amar leh: bechamma? amar leh: befalga dezuza. yehav leh.

Lesof, amar leh: ana resha dechevta amari lach? amar leh: i baet deeshbekach saggi achvi li pitcha deve attuna. amar leh: mistefena dechol demachve katli leh. amar leh: deri kericha dikne, vechi matet lehatam zikfe keman deka mittefach.
Ashkach darbenae miggavvay vedarbenae mibbaray, dei chazu kara deayyla — katli lehu levaray, udenafka — katli lehu legavvay.
Afche lesandaleh — katli lehu legavvae, afche lesandaleh — katli lehu lechullehu.
Ashkach yanoke milleel, save milletachat. amar: i yahevna shelama lehane, katli li hane, savri: anan adifinan, daanan kashshinan tefe veinhu dardakke.

Amar: shelama lechu. amaru leh: may avidtaych? amar lehu: ana chakkima dihudae ana, baena lemigmar chuchmeta minnayychu. i hachi, nive lach! amar lehu: lechayye, i zachetu — kol devaetu avidu bi, vei zachena bechu — ichlu gabbay bisfinta.
Amaru leh: hahu gavra deazel uvae itteta vela yahavu leh, may chaze leh deazel hecha demiddelu minnay? shekal sikketa, datza letattay — la al, leillay — al. amar: hay name mitreme bat mazzaleh.
Gavra deozef vetaref, may chaza dahadar ozef? amar lehu: gavra azal leagma, ketal kamma tuna vela matze beh, katel umannach illaveh, ad (deitremi) [demitreme] inish madle leh.

Amaru leh: ema lan mille divdii! amar lehu: hava hahiv kudanyeta dilida, vahava tele leh pitka, uchetav beh demassek beve abba mea alpa zuze. amaru leh: vechudanyeta mi yalda? amar lehu: (he nihu) [hane ninhu] mille divdii.
Milcha ki sarya, bemay malchi la? amar lehu: besilta dechudanyeta. umi ikka silta lechudanta? umilcha mi sere?

Beni lan beta baavira dealma! amar shem, tela ben rekia leara. amar lehu: assiku li livne vetina. metziateh dealma hecha? zakfa leetzbateh, amar lehu: hacha. amaru leh: umi yemar? ayyto ashle umeshachu.
It lan bera bedavra, ayyle lemata! amar lehu: afshilu li chavle mippare vaaayyeyleh. it lan richya ditvira, chayyeytay. amar: keruchu li minnay garde veichayyeytay.
Meshara desakkine bemay katli? bekarna dachamara. umi ikka karna lachamara? umi ikka meshara desakkine?
Ayyto leh tere bee, amaru leh: he dezagta ukkamti vehe dezagta chivvavrti? ayyti lehu ihu tere gevine, amar lehu: he deizza ukkamti vehe deizza chivvavrti?

Vartzutza demit, mehecha nafek rucheh? mehecha deal nefak. achvi lan mana dela shave chavileh! ayyti (kol chad vechad) budeya, pashteh. la hava ayel betara. amar lehu: ayyto mare sitru. hayeynu mana dela shave chavileh.
Aytinhu kol chad vechad, ki chaze shittin bistarke, amar: kullehu chavray lehacha atu. amar leh lesafona: sheri sefintach. bahade dekaatu shekal afra meafrayyhu.

a: Ki mate leve velie, mela kuza demayya mibbe velie. kad ato, okminhu kamme kesar. chazanhu dahavo meanni, amar leh: hane lav ninhu. shekal meafrayyhu usheda illavayyhu, aksho leappe malka. amar leh: kol devaet aved behu.
Ayytinhu mayya deayyti mibbe velie, shedinhu betigda, amar lehu: malyu lehu veezilu lechu. melo ushedo beh kammae kammae, uvela lehu, melo ad deshamet katpayyhu, uvelo lehu vaazul.
Mishna chamora shello bikkera veyalda shene zecharim — noten tale echad lakkohen, zachar unekeva — mafrish tale echad leatzmo.

Shete chamorav shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim — noten shene telaim lakkohen. zachar unekeva, o shene zecharim unekeva — noten tale echad lakkohen. shete nekevot vezachar, o shene zecharim ushete nekevot — en lakkohen kelum.
Achat bikkera, veachat shello bikkera, veyalda shene zecharim — noten tale echad lakkohen; zachar unekeva — mafrish tale echad leatzmo.
Shenneemar: "ufeter chamor tifde vese", min hakkevasim umin haizzim, zachar unekeva, gadol vekatan, tamim uvaal mum, pode bo peamim harebe, nichnas ledir lehitasser, veim met — nehenin bo.
Gemara man tanna? amar rabbi yirmeya: dela kerabbi yose haggelili, dei rabbi yose haggelili — haamar efshar letzamtzem!
Amar abbaye: afillu tema rabbi yose haggelili, shane hatam dichtiv "hazzecharim laAdonai".
Veligmar minneh! ha mayet rachamana "hazzecharim".
Ikka deamri: lema dela kerabbi yose haggelili, dei rabbi yose haggelili — haamar efshar letzamtzem! amar abbaye: afillu tema rabbi yose haggelili, shane hatam dichtiv "hazzecharim laAdonai".
Bishlama lerabbi yirmeya, dela moke la kerabbi yose haggelili — hayeynu dela katane "veyatzu shene rashehen keechad", ella leabbaye — litne "veyatzu shene rashehen keechad"!
Veod, tanya: chamoro shello bikkera veyalda shene zecharim, veyatzu shene rashehen keechad, rabbi yose haggelili omer: shenehen lakkohen, shenneemar "hazzecharim laAdonai".
Veha ki ketiv hay, bikdushshat hagguf hu dichtiv! ella mishshum shenneemar "hazzecharim laAdonai", teyuveta deabbaye, teyuveta.
b: Verabbanan, lema kasavri rabbanan miktzat rechem makdesh? dei kulleh rechem makdesh — nehi dei efshar letzamtzem, chatzitza miha ikka!
Amar rav: min bemino eno chotzetz.
Zachar unekeva — mafrish tale kulei. vechevan dilatzmo hu, lema li leafroshe? leafkoe leissureh minneh.
Alma, kevan dela mafka leissureh, asur bahanaa. matnitin manni? rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: peter chamor asur bahanaa, verabbi shimon mattir.
May tama derabbi yehuda? amar ulla: yesh lecha davar shetztzarich pediyyay umuttar? vela?! vahare bechor adam shetztzarich pediyyay umuttar! ella, yesh lecha davar shehikpida alav tora bese umuttar?

Umi hikpida?! veha rav nechemya bereh derav yosef parek leh beshilke beshovyo! beshovyo la kaamrinan, ki kaamrinan shello beshovyo, vehachi kaamar: yesh lecha davar shehikpida alav tora leafkoe leissureh bese?
Vahare maaser, shehikpida alav tora bechesef tzori, utenan: rabbi yehuda omer: bemezid — kiddesh!
Befeter chamor name mikkaddesha, kidrabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: ishsha yodaat sheen maaser sheni mitchallel al yadah, veola veochalto birushalayim.
Hacha name, ishsha yodaat defeter chamor issura it beh, ufarka leh bese, umakdesha behach devene uvene.
Verabbi shimon may tame? amar ulla: yesh lecha davar sheppidyono muttar vehu asur?
Vela? vahare sheviit, defidyonah muttar, vehi asura!
Sheviit name pidyonah asur, deamar mar: haacharon acharon asur.

Veibbaet ema: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon behay kera kamippalgi, detanya: "lo taavod bivchor shorecha" — aval atta oved beshellecha uveshel acherim, "velo tagoz bechor tzonecha" — aval atta gozez shellecha veshel acherim, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: "lo taavod bivchor shorecha" — aval atta oved bivchor adam, "lo tagoz bechor tzonecha" — aval atta gozez bechor chamor.
Bishlama lerabbi shimon, hayeynu dichtiv tere kerae, ella lerabbi yehuda, tere kerae lemaote shellecha veshel acherim lema li? vetu lerabbi yehuda, bechor adam name nema daasir!
Ella dechulle alma "shorecha" lemaote bechor adam hu daata, ki peligi betzonecha". derabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: shuttafut goy chayyevet bivchora, vechi itzterich kera lemishre begizza vaavoda.
Verabbi shimon savar: shuttafut goy petura min habbechora, uleinyan gizza vaavoda la itzterich kera, ki itzterich kera lefeter chamor.
Bishlama lerabbi yehuda, hayeynu dichtiv "tzonecha" veshorecha", attu "tzonecha". ella lerabbi shimon, "shorecha" vetzonecha" lema li? kashya.
Amar rabba: umode rabbi shimon leachar arifa, shehu asur.
May tama? gamar "arifa" "arifa" meegla arufa.
Amar rava: mena amena leh detanya: haorla vechile hakkerem, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa, vetzippore metzora, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav — kullan mittammein tumeat ovchalin.
Rabbi shimon omer: kullan en mittammein tumeat ovchalin, umode rabbi shimon bevasar bechalav shemmetamme tumeat ovchalin, hoil vehayta lo sheat hakkosher.

Veamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi shimon? dichtiv: "mikkol haochel asher yeachel", ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim — karuy ochel, shei atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim — eno karuy ochel.

a: I hachi, basar bechalav may irya dehayta lah sheat hakkosher? tippok li deochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu!

Detanya, rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: basar bechalav asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, shenneemar: "ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha", ulehallan hu omer: "veanshe kodesh tihyun li", ma lehallan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, af kan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa!
Chada veod kaamar: chada — deochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu, veod — ledideh name hare hayta lo sheat hakkosher.
Veim ita dilachar arifa share rabbi shimon, litne: umode rabbi shimon befeter chamor uvasar bechalav shemmittammein tumeat ovchalin!
I dechashshev aleh — hachi name; hacha bemay askinan — dela chashshev aleh.
Vetama may metammei rabbanan? amruha rabbanan kammeh derav sheshet: hoil veissuro chishshuvo.
Ulerabbanan mi amar hoil veissuro chishshuvo? veha tenan: shelosha asar devarim amru benivlat of tahor, vezo achat mehen — tzericha machshava, veenah tzericha hechsher.
Vei issuro chishshuvo, lema li machshava? ha manni? rabbi shimon hi.

Ta shema: nivlat behema temea bechol makom, venivlat of tahor vehachelev bakkefarim — tzerichim machshava, veenam tzerichim hechsher. vei amrat issuro chishshuvo, lema li machshava? ha manni? rabbi shimon hi.
Ta shema: nivlat behema tehora bechol makom, venivlat of hattahor vehachelev bashshevavkim — enan tzerichin machshava velo hechsher. ha temea baaya machshava.

Vechi tema: ha manni rabbi shimon hi — ha middesefa rabbi shimon have, resha lav rabbi shimon. dekatane sefa: rabbi shimon omer: af haggamal vehaarnevet vehashshafan vehachazir enan tzerichin lo machshava velo hechsher. veamar rabbi shimon: ma taam? hoil veyesh bahen simane tohora.
Ella amar rava: dechulle alma la amrinan issuro chishshuvo, vei dearfeh miraf — hachi name,
b: Hacha bemay askinan? kegon sheshshechato lehitlammed bo, uviflugeta denimos verabbi eliezer.
Detanya, amar rabbi yose: sach li nimos, achiv shel rabbi yehoshua haggarsi, shehashshochet et haorev lehitlammed bo — damo machshir. rabbi eliezer omer: dam shechita leolam machshir.
Rabbi eliezer hayeynu tanna kamma! ella lav issuro chishshuvo ikka benayyhu.
Tanna kamma savar: damo machshir lealma, aval legufeh bae machshava.
Vaata rabbi eliezer lememar: dam shechita leolam machshir, vaafillu legufeh name la bae machshava.
Mimmay? dilma tama derabbi eliezer hatam — deshane orev, hoil veyesh bo simane tohora.
Umenalan desimane tohora milleta hi? dekatane ala dehahi, amar rabbi shimon: ma taam? hoil veyesh bo simane tohora.
Vechi tema: i mishshum simane tohora, may irya lehitlammed? afillu lehitassek name! in hachi name, umishshum nimos.
Etiveh: lo ratza lifdoto — orfo bekofitz meachorav vekovro, veasur bahanaa, divre rabbi yehuda, verabbi shimon mattir!
Ema: umechayyim asur bahanaa, verabbi shimon mattir.
Veha middesefa mechayyim have, resha lav mechayyim.

Dekatane sefa: lo yemitennu, lo bekane velo bemaggal velo bekardom velo bimgera, velo yachnisennu lacheder veyinol delet lefanav bishvil sheyyamut, veasur begizza vaavoda, divre rabbi yehuda, verabbi shimon mattir!
Resha vesefa mechayyim, resha — bahanaat damav, sefa — bahanaat gufo.

Utzericha, dei tena hanaat damav — behahu ka share rabbi shimon, aval bahanaat gufo ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda. vei tena bahanaat gufo — behahi kaasar rabbi yehuda, aval bahanaat damav ema mode lerabbi shimon. tzericha.
Vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: mode rabbi shimon leachar arifa shehu asur.
Veamar rav nachman: mena amena la? detanya: "vaarafto", neemar kan arifa, veneemar lehallan arifa, ma lehallan asur — af kan asur.
Manni? ilema rabbi yehuda — mechayyim mesar asar! ella lav rabbi shimon hi?
Amar leh rav sheshet: safra chavraych targuma: leolam rabbi yehuda, veitzterich, salka datach amena: arifa bimkom pediyyay omedet, ma pediyyay matteret — af arifa matteret, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav nachman: mena amena la? middetane levi: hu hifsid mamono shel kohen, lefichach yufesad mamono.
Manni? ilema rabbi yehuda — ha mayfsad vekae! ella lav rabbi shimon hi?
Ibbaet ema: rabbi yehuda, veibbaet ema rabbi shimon.
Ibbaet ema: rabbi yehuda, appeseda devene bene.
Veibbaet ema: rabbi shimon, lifchat mita.
Vechen amar resh lakish: mode rabbi shimon leachar arifa shehu asur, verabbi yochanan, vei tema rabbi elazar amar: adayin hi machloket.
Ikka dematne la leha derav nachman, aha: "hamekaddesh befeter chamor enah mekuddeshet". lema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: leachar arifa, vedivre hakkol.
Ikka deamri: ha manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi shimon. i rabbi shimon — tikdash bechulleh, i rabbi yehuda — tikdash behach devene bene!

Amar rabba bar avu amar rav: leolam rabbi yehuda, uchegon sheeno shave ella shekel, vesavar la kerabbi yose bar yehuda. detanya: "tifde" "tifde" — tifde miyyad, tifde kol shehu. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: en pediyyay pechuta mishshekel.
Amar mar: "tifde" "tifde" — tifde miyyad, tifde kol shehu. peshita!
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veittakkash livchor adam, ma bechor adam achar sheloshim vechamesh, hay name achar sheloshim vechamesh.
Ka mashma lan: "tifde" — miyyad, "tifde" — kol shehu.
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: en pediyyay pechuta mishshekel. mimma nafshach: i makkesh livchor adam — chamesh live, vei la makkesh — shekel mena leh?
Leolam la makkesh, amar rava: amar kera "vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh", kol arachin sheatta maarich lo yehu pechutin mishshekel.
Verabbanan: hahu

a: Behesseg yad ketiv.
Amar rav nachman: halacha kedivre chachamim, vechamma? amar rav yosef: afillu patroza bar danka, amar rava: af anan name tenena gadol vekatan.
Peshita! mahu detema kulle hay la? i name, patroza la? ka mashma lan.
Rabbi yehuda nesia hava leh peter chamor, shaddereh lekammeh derabbi tarfon, amar leh: kamma baena lemittav lechohen? amar leh: hare amru: ayin yafa besela, ayin raa beshekel, benonit berigya.
Amar rava: hilcheta berigya. vechamma? telata zuze. regil hacha veragil hacha.
Kashya hilcheta ahilcheta! la kashya, kan — beva limmalech, kan — beose meatzmo.
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar resh lakish: mi sheyyesh lo peter chamor veen lo se lifdoto — podehu beshovyo. leman? ilema lerabbi yehuda — ha amar: hikpida alav tora bese! ella lerabbi shimon.
Rav acha matni hachi, ravina kashya leh: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon — halacha kerabbi yehuda!
Usetam lan tanna kerabbi yehuda, veat amrat halacha kerabbi shimon?!
Ella, afillu tema rabbi yehuda, lo yehe chamur min hahekdesh, velo amra tora "bese" lehachemir alav ella lehakel alav. rav nachman bereh derav yosef parek leh beshilke beshovyo.
Amar rav shezvi amar rav huna: happode peter chamor shel chavero, pidyono paduy. ibbaya lehu: pidyono lappode, o dilma pidyono labbealim?
Allibba derabbi shimon la tibbee lach, kevan deamar muttar bahanaa — mamona divalim hu, ki tibbee allibba derabbi yehuda, deamar asur bahanaa.
Lehekdesh medamme leh, verachamana amar: "venatan hakkesef vekam lo", o dilma, kevan dekane lehu bevene uvene, la dame lehekdesh?
Amar rav nachman, ta shema: haggonev peter chamor shel chavero — meshallem tashlume chefel labbealim, veaf al pi sheen lo achshav — yesh lo leachar mikkan.
Manni? ilema rabbi shimon, ammay en lo achshav? ella peshita rabbi yehuda.
Vei salka datach lehekdesh medammenan leh, "vegunnav mibbet haish" amar rachamana, velo mibbet hekdesh! vetu la midde.
Achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera [kulei]. tanu rabbanan: ketzad amru nichnas ledir lehitasser?

I atta yachol lomar beva leyad kohen, shehare shaninu: hallakuach veshennittan lo bemattana patur mimmasar behema, ella beyisrael shehayu lo asara sefek pitre chamorim betoch beto, shemmafrish alehen asara seyin, umeasseran, vehen shello.
Mesayyay leh lerav nachman, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: yisrael shehayu lo asara sefek pitre chamorim — mafrish alehen asara seyin, umeasseran, vehen shello.
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: yisrael shehayu lo asara pitre chamorim vaddain betoch beto, shennaflu mibbet avi immo kohen, veoto avi immo kohen naflu lo mibbet avi immo yisrael.
Mafrish alehen asara seyin, umeasseran, vehen shello.

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: yisrael shehayu lo tevalim memorachin betoch beto, shennaflu mibbet avi immo kohen, veoto avi immo kohen naflu lo mibbet avi immo yisrael — measseran vehen shello.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan kammayyta — mishshum deka mafraysh vekae.
Aval hacha — mattanot shello huremu kemi shello huremu damyayn, ema la.
Vei ashmevinan hacha — deefshar leassore minneh uveh, deha mannach, aval hatam — kevan dese mealma bae etoye, umafraysh vekae, ema la, tzericha.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar natan amar rabbi chanina: hallokeach tevalim
b: Memorachin min haggoy, measseran vehen shello.
Demarchinhu man? ilema demarchinhu goy — "degancha" amar rachamana, velo degan goy!

Ella demarchinhu yisrael mershut goy. measseran, deen kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafekia miyyad maaser, vehen shello — deamar leh: kaatena mikkoach gavra dela matzet (ishtaet) [ishtaoye] dina bahadeh.
Tenan hatam: hammafkid perotav etzel hakkuti veetzel am haaretz, bechezkatan lammaaser velashsheviit.
Etzel haggoy — keferotav, rabbi shimon omer: demay.
Amar rabbi elazar: lehaferish — kulle alma la peligi, ki peligi — littenan lechohen. tanna kamma savar: vadday challefinhu, uvae mittenanhu lechohen, verabbi shimon savar: demay.

Yatev rav dimi vekaamar leha shemata, amar leh abbaye: tama dimsappeka lan i challefinhu i la challefinhu, ha vadday challefinhu — dechulle alma bae lemittevinhu lechohen, vehaamar rabbi shemuel amar rabbi chanina: hallokeach tevalim min haggoy memorachin — measseran vehen shello!
Dilma kan bitruma gedola, kan bitrumat maaser!

Azkartan milleta deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin lallokeach tevalim memorachin min haggoy shehu patur mitterumat maaser? shenneemar: "veel haleviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem ki tikchu meet bene yisrael", tevalim sheatta lokeach mibbene yisrael — atta mafrish mehen terumat maaser venotnah lakkohen, tevalim sheatta lokeach min haggoy — i atta mafrish mehen terumat maaser venotnah lakkohen.
Veim met nehenim bo. demit hecha? illema demit be chohen, venehene bo kohen — peshita, mamona dideh hu! ella, demit be vealim venehene bo kohen — ha name peshita!
Salka datach amena, kol kamma dela meta lideh la zecha beh, ka mashma lan demeiddana deafresheh, birshuteh dechohen kae.
